Trigger.Name: PRE-TEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
:global.double := '';
set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.drive_date',FORMAT_MASK,'FXMMDDYYYY');

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :ctrl_block_1.drive_id != :ctrl_block_1.d_drive_id then
 show_error('16002');

 go_item('ctrl_block_1.drive_date');
 clear_record;
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
else
 next_item;
end if;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 nCount NUMBER:=0;
BEGIN
 --If health history or physical findings has been completred, then this function is not allowed
 
IF :ctrl_block_1.id_verified is null or :ctrl_block_1.id_verified!='Y' then 
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.id_verified');
 show_error('21124');
ELSE
 
 select nvl(count(*),0) into nCount from online_status where
 transaction_id=:ctrl_block_1.transaction_id and 
 (HLTH_HIST_START is not null OR PHY_FINDINGS_START is not null);

 If nCount > 0 then
 show_error('21062');
 check_package_failure; 
 Else
 go_block('deferral');
 item_change('deferral.incident_date','D');
 item_change('deferral.deferred_thru_date','D');
 item_change('deferral.def_reason','D');
 show_window('win_def');
 go_item('deferral.donor_inquiry');
 End if;
END IF;

END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
init_view('don_picture'); 
show_view('don_picture'); 
go_item('donor_picture_ctrl.s_file_name');
synchronize;

 :donations.donation_type:=null;
 :donations.procedure_code:=null;

End;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
Begin
 go_block('valid_proc_codes');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 :system.message_level:=10;
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level:=0;
 first_record;
End;

Item.Name: AGE_MONTH
Item.Hint: Enter a valid Zip code or select from LISTVAL

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 dnr_id VARCHAR2 (10);
 emp_id VARCHAR2 (10);
 sub_msg VARCHAR2 (50);
 lnkunitflg VARCHAR2 (2);
 interlink VARCHAR2 (2);
 efailure EXCEPTION;
 interfail EXCEPTION;
 alert_id NUMBER;
 idtype VARCHAR2 (10);
 v_out VARCHAR2 (250);
 o_out VARCHAR2 (250);
 inter_status VARCHAR2 (10);
 flgdnrstopped VARCHAR2 (1);
 flgstatus VARCHAR2 (1) := 'P';
 dtendlkup DATE;
 ngallonval NUMBER := TO_NUMBER (LTRIM (:GLOBAL.gallon_value));
 verror VARCHAR2 (50);
 hhcount NUMBER := 0;
 phycount NUMBER := 0;
 nholdcount NUMBER := 0;
 tcount NUMBER := 0;
 v_dummy_ssn VARCHAR2 (20);
 nhl7dn NUMBER := 0;
 nhl7count NUMBER := 0;
 nidpproc NUMBER := 0;
 pl_err_flag VARCHAR2 (1);
 pl_err_msg VARCHAR2 (300);
 online_count NUMBER := 0;
 insert_status VARCHAR2 (10);
 cnt_id_queue NUMBER := 0;
 vmsg VARCHAR2 (200);
 chk_zip NUMBER := 0;
 v_multi_chapter VARCHAR2(1);
 v_chapter_id chapters.chapter_id %type;
 chp_sysdate DATE;
BEGIN

 -- 
 SET_EXT_GLOBAL; -- IM 48 
 --- 
 
 -- AV; 05/27/2011
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 
/* New code added by Touqeer for SCR# 16200*/-- modified on 04/05/11 - to include international address and 'Do you want to Save changes' error msg.
--START
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY ('donor_addresses.street_name', enabled) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF :donor_addresses.street_name IS NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM ('donor_addresses.street_name');
 --nullchk;
 show_error('0080',' - Address');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSIF :donor_addresses.city IS NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM ('donor_addresses.city');
 --nullchk;
 show_error('0080',' - City');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSIF :donor_addresses.zip IS NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM ('donor_addresses.zip');
 show_error('0080',' - Zip');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO chk_zip
 FROM valid_city_state
 WHERE UPPER (city) = :donor_addresses.city
 AND :donor_addresses.zip IN (SELECT zip
 FROM valid_city_state
 WHERE UPPER (city) = :donor_addresses.city);
 IF chk_zip = 0 THEN
 SET_ALERT_PROPERTY ('inform_alert', alert_message_text, 'Please, correct the zip code.');
 alert_id := SHOW_ALERT ('inform_alert');
 IF alert_id = alert_button1 THEN
 GO_ITEM ('donor_addresses.city');
 show_error ('0080', ' - City');
 --nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 END IF;
 END IF; 
 ELSE
 IF :donor_addresses.intl_address_1 IS NULL THEN
 show_error ('0080', ' : International Address 1');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSIF :donor_addresses.country_name IS NULL THEN
 show_error ('0080', ' : Country name');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF :donors.alternate_id IS NOT NULL AND :donors.alternate_id_type IS NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM ('donors.alternate_id_type');
 --nullchk;
 show_error('0080',' - Alternate ID type');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 

 IF :donor_addresses.employer_name IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF NVL(:donor_addresses.s_emp_intl_flag,'N')= 'Y' then 
 IF ( :donor_addresses.emp_intl_city IS NULL
 -- OR :donor_addresses.emp_intl_state IS NULL
 -- OR :donor_addresses.emp_intl_postal IS NULL
 OR :donor_addresses.emp_intl_country IS NULL 
 ) THEN 
 go_item('donor_addresses.emp_intl_city');
 show_error('0080 ' || ' : International Address');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF (:donor_addresses.e_city IS NULL 
 OR :donor_addresses.e_zip IS NULL
 ) THEN 
 GO_ITEM ('donor_addresses.employer_name');
 show_error('0080', ' : City or Zip ');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 -- Step: 1 Check for missing data
 
 -- 01/15/2015 -- -- IM 10287 -- new check added to validate with FD alterante ID entry.
 check_fd_entry('ALT_ID'); 
 check_fd_entry('ALT_ID_TYPE');
 -- 
 
 IF :ctrl_block_1.id_verified IS NULL OR :ctrl_block_1.id_verified != 'Y' THEN
 GO_ITEM ('ctrl_block_1.id_verified');
 --nullchk;
 show_error('0080',' - ID Verified');
 check_package_failure; 
 ELSIF :donations.donation_type IS NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM ('donations.donation_type');
 --nullchk;
 show_error('0080',' - Donation Type');
 check_package_failure; 
 ELSIF :donations.procedure_code IS NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM ('donations.procedure_code');
 --nullchk;
 show_error('0080',' - Procedure Code');
 check_package_failure; 
 ELSE -- if no missing data then proceed
--STOP

 /* ********************************************************************************* */
 --Step 7: --- priority 8 ( point 3) will go here --- staa
 /*-- new code for scr# 16203 */
 :GLOBAL.alt_id := :donors.alternate_id;
 :GLOBAL.alt_typ := :donors.alternate_id_type;

 IF :GLOBAL.alt_id IS NOT NULL AND :GLOBAL.alt_typ IS NULL THEN
 SET_ALERT_PROPERTY ('ALT_ID_ALERT',
 alert_message_text,
 'Alt ID will not be save without Alt Type.'
 );
 alert_id := SHOW_ALERT ('ALT_ID_ALERT');
 :donors.alternate_id := NULL;
 END IF;

 IF :GLOBAL.alt_id IS NULL AND :GLOBAL.alt_typ IS NOT NULL THEN
 SET_ALERT_PROPERTY ('ALT_ID_ALERT',
 alert_message_text,
 'Alt Type will not be save without Alt ID.'
 );
 alert_id := SHOW_ALERT ('ALT_ID_ALERT');
 :donors.alternate_id_type := NULL;
 END IF;

/* ********************************************************************************* */
 :GLOBAL.elig := :ctrl_block_1.elig_desc;
/*********************************************************************************************/

 --Step 2: Create new employer record, if the employer is new
 IF :GLOBAL.laptop_transfer = 'N'
 THEN
 IF :GLOBAL.createnewemp IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 IF (:donor_addresses.employer_name IS NOT NULL
 AND :donor_addresses.e_zip IS NOT NULL)
 OR (:donor_addresses.emp_intl_city IS NOT NULL
 AND :donor_addresses.emp_intl_country IS NOT NULL
 ) THEN
 BEGIN
 get_correct_id_type ('DNEMP', idtype);
 -- it can be DNEMP or DNEMP0 or DNEMP1 depends on the laptop # sequence
 create_ids (idtype, emp_id);
 INSERT INTO donor_employers
 (employer_id, chapter_id,
 employer_name,
 usps_id,
 program_id, eff_date,
 intl_city,
 intl_state,
 intl_postal_code,
 intl_country_name,
 intl_addr_flag
 )
 VALUES (emp_id, :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :donor_addresses.employer_name,
 :donor_addresses.e_usps_id,
 :banner.prog_name, TRUNC (chp_sysdate),
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_city,
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_state,
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_postal,
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_country,
 :donor_addresses.s_emp_intl_flag
 );
 :donor_addresses.employer_id := emp_id;
 :donors.employer_id := emp_id;
 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 MESSAGE
 ('Could not create New Employer - Check the table and the data'
 );
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSIF :GLOBAL.laptop_transfer = 'Y'
 THEN
 IF :GLOBAL.createnewemp IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 IF (:donor_addresses.employer_name IS NOT NULL
 AND :donor_addresses.e_zip IS NOT NULL)
 OR (:donor_addresses.emp_intl_city IS NOT NULL
 AND :donor_addresses.emp_intl_country IS NOT NULL
 ) THEN
 BEGIN
 create_temp_id (emp_id, pl_err_flag, pl_err_msg);

 IF NVL (pl_err_flag, ' ') = 'N'
 THEN
 INSERT INTO donor_employers
 (employer_id, chapter_id,
 employer_name,
 usps_id,
 program_id, eff_date,
 intl_city,
 intl_state,
 intl_postal_code,
 intl_country_name,
 intl_addr_flag
 )
 VALUES (emp_id, :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :donor_addresses.employer_name,
 :donor_addresses.e_usps_id,
 :banner.prog_name, TRUNC (chp_sysdate),
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_city,
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_state,
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_postal,
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_country,
 :donor_addresses.s_emp_intl_flag
 );
 :donor_addresses.employer_id := emp_id;
 :donors.employer_id := emp_id;
 ELSE
 MESSAGE (pl_err_msg);
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 MESSAGE
 ('Could not create New Employer - Check the table and the data'
 );
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

/* ************************************************************************************ */

 -- Step 3: Create a record into the online_status table if you register
 IF :GLOBAL.donor_stopped = 'Y'
 THEN
 flgdnrstopped := 'R';
 --flgStatus:='D';
 ELSE
 flgdnrstopped := NULL;
 flgstatus := 'P';

 DELETE FROM donor_interdictions
 WHERE transaction_id = :ctrl_block_1.transaction_id
 AND donor_id = :ctrl_block_1.donor_id
 AND originated_from = 'INQR'; -- Added ON 02-21-05
 END IF;

 SELECT SYSDATE
 INTO dtendlkup
 FROM DUAL;

 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY ('ctrl_block_1.pb_register', label) = 'Register'
 THEN
 SELECT NVL (COUNT (*), 0)
 INTO tcount
 FROM online_status
 WHERE transaction_id = :ctrl_block_1.transaction_id;

 IF tcount = 0
 THEN
 INSERT INTO online_status
 (transaction_id,
 lookup_start, lookup_end,
 lkup_ovr_rsn, lkup_updt_by,
 lkup_updt_time, hlth_hist_start, hlth_hist_end,
 hlth_hist_ovr_rsn, hlth_updt_by, hlth_updt_time,
 phy_findings_start, phy_findings_end, phy_ovr_rsn,
 phy_updt_by, phy_updt_time, phelob_start,
 phelob_end, phelob_updt_by, phelob_updt_time,
 donor_stopped_at, status_flag, donor_id,
 drive_id, drive_date,
 donor_id_verified
 )
 VALUES (:ctrl_block_1.transaction_id,
 :ctrl_block_1.lookup_start_time, dtendlkup,
 :ctrl_blk_2.rsn_cde, :GLOBAL.lookup_user,
 dtendlkup, NULL, NULL,
 NULL, NULL, NULL,
 NULL, NULL, NULL,
 NULL, NULL, NULL,
 NULL, NULL, NULL,
 flgdnrstopped, flgstatus, :ctrl_block_1.donor_id,
 :ctrl_block_1.drive_id, :ctrl_block_1.drive_date,
 :ctrl_block_1.id_verified
 );

 -- For IDP interface. Added to support the Vista 04/16/06
 IF :GLOBAL.idp_fcn = 'Y'
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT NVL (COUNT (*), 0)
 INTO nidpproc
 FROM valid_master_codes
 WHERE code_type = 'IDPPC'
 AND code = :donations.procedure_code
 AND SYSDATE BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL (term_date,
 SYSDATE + 1
 );

 IF nidpproc > 0
 THEN
 UPDATE online_status
 SET idp_proc_code = :donations.procedure_code,
 idp_proc_status = 'R',
 idp_proc_status_dats = SYSDATE
 WHERE transaction_id = :ctrl_block_1.transaction_id;
 ELSE
 NULL;
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 /*------------the following is added for HL7 only ------------------------------------- */
 IF :GLOBAL.hl7_fcn = 'Y'
 THEN
 SELECT NVL (COUNT (*), 0)
 INTO nhl7count
 FROM hl7_interface_log
 WHERE transaction_id = :ctrl_block_1.transaction_id;

 SELECT NVL (COUNT (*), 0)
 INTO nhl7dn
 FROM valid_master_codes
 WHERE code_type = 'HL7DN'
 AND code = :donations.donation_type
 AND SYSDATE BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL (term_date, SYSDATE + 1);

 IF nhl7count = 0
 THEN
 IF nhl7dn = 0
 THEN
 INSERT INTO hl7_interface_log
 (transaction_id,
 donor_id, adt_gen_flag, orm_gen_flag,
 generate_date, lock_by, insert_date
 )
 VALUES (:ctrl_block_1.transaction_id,
 :ctrl_block_1.donor_id, NULL, NULL,
 NULL, NULL, SYSDATE
 );
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 /* -------------------Addition Ends here ------------------------------------------------*/
 ELSE
 UPDATE online_status
 SET lkup_updt_by = lt_user_session.get_userid,
 lkup_updt_time = dtendlkup,
 status_flag = flgstatus,
 donor_id_verified =
 NVL (:ctrl_block_1.id_verified, donor_id_verified),
 lkup_ovr_rsn = :ctrl_blk_2.rsn_cde
 WHERE transaction_id = :donations.transaction_id;
 END IF;

/* ********************************************************************************* */

 --Step 4: If the donor is stopped at Lookup, place the interdiction
 IF :GLOBAL.donor_stopped = 'Y'
 THEN
 -- This is set in the initialise windows and deferal window apply button
 BEGIN
 v_out := NULL;

 IF :GLOBAL.action = 'NEW'
 THEN
-- for the new donor donor id needs to present in the table for placing interdictions
 :SYSTEM.message_level := 10;
 POST;
 GO_BLOCK ('donations');
 EXECUTE_QUERY;
 :SYSTEM.message_level := 0;
 END IF;

 IF :valid_hh_answers.inter_code IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 defer_donor (:ctrl_block_1.donor_id,
 :valid_hh_answers.inter_code,
 NVL (:deferral.incident_date, chp_SYSDATE),
 :deferral.deferred_thru_date,
 NVL (:deferral.def_reason, 'At Donor Inquiry'),
 'INQR',
 :valid_hh_answers.question_code,
 :valid_hh_answers.answer_code,
 v_out
 );

 IF v_out != 'OK'
 THEN
 MESSAGE (v_out);
 RAISE interfail;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;

/* *************************************************************************** */

 --Step 4.a : If the donor interdiction is passed, just create a record
 IF :GLOBAL.donor_stopped = 'O'
 THEN
 -- This is set in the initialise windows and deferal window apply button
 BEGIN
 v_out := NULL;

 IF :GLOBAL.action = 'NEW'
 THEN
-- for the new donor donor id needs to present in the table for placing interdictions
 :SYSTEM.message_level := 10;
 POST;
 GO_BLOCK ('donations');
 EXECUTE_QUERY;
 :SYSTEM.message_level := 0;
 END IF;

 IF :valid_hh_answers.inter_code IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 defer_donor (:ctrl_block_1.donor_id,
 :valid_hh_answers.inter_code,
 NVL (:deferral.incident_date, chp_SYSDATE),
 :deferral.deferred_thru_date,
 NVL (:deferral.def_reason, 'At Donor Inquiry'),
 'INQR',
 :valid_hh_answers.question_code,
 :valid_hh_answers.answer_code,
 v_out
 );

 IF v_out != 'OK'
 THEN
 MESSAGE (v_out);
 RAISE interfail;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;

 /* *********Added on 06-09-04******************************************** */

 --Stpe 4.b If the donor is not eligible, place DNELG hold
 IF :ctrl_block_1.allowed_to_donate_flg = 'N'
 THEN
 --select nvl(count(*),0) into nHoldCount from donation_interdictions where
 --transaction_id=:ctrl_block_1.transaction_id and inter_code='DNELG' and release_date is null;
 IF :GLOBAL.screen_mode = 'AUTO'
 THEN
 place_dnelg_hold;
 END IF;
 END IF;

/* ************************************************************************** */

 --Step 5: Check for Duplicate donor . If present place the appropriate interdictions or hold
 IF :GLOBAL.action = 'DUPLICATE'
 THEN
 -- Clean up first if this donor information is already in the system for the same transaction
 -- so that if the user comes here again for some update , the information will not be created second time.
 DELETE FROM donation_interdictions
 WHERE transaction_id = :ctrl_block_1.transaction_id
 AND reason_code = 'DUPLI';

 DELETE FROM donor_interdictions
 WHERE transaction_id = :ctrl_block_1.transaction_id
 AND reason_code = 'DUPLI';

 DELETE FROM inter_transactions
 WHERE transaction_id = :ctrl_block_1.transaction_id
 AND reason_code = 'DUPLI';

 DELETE FROM potential_duplicates
 WHERE transaction_id = :ctrl_block_1.transaction_id;

 DELETE FROM graded_donations
 WHERE transaction_id = :ctrl_block_1.transaction_id;

 DELETE FROM graded_donors
 WHERE transaction_id = :ctrl_block_1.transaction_id;

 :SYSTEM.message_level := 10;
 POST;
 :SYSTEM.message_level := 0;
 -- Now place
 place_inter_on_dup_donors (inter_status);

 IF inter_status != 'OK'
 THEN
 RAISE interfail;
 END IF;
 END IF;

/* ********************************************************************************* */
--Step 6:
/*-- new code for scr# 16203 */
 BEGIN
 SELECT NVL (COUNT (*), 0)
 INTO online_count
 FROM online_status
 WHERE transaction_id = :ctrl_block_1.transaction_id;

 IF online_count = 0
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT 'Err:21127' || error
 INTO vmsg
 FROM valid_errors
 WHERE ERROR_CODE = '21127';
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 vmsg :=
 'ONLINE_STATUS table is not populated, form will be cleard';
 END;

 SET_ALERT_PROPERTY ('ERROR_ALERT', alert_message_text, vmsg);
 alert_id := SHOW_ALERT ('ERROR_ALERT');

 IF alert_id = alert_button1
 THEN
 RAISE interfail;
 ELSE
 RAISE interfail; -- IM 6215;02/24/2012
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END;

/* ********************************************************************************* */
--step 7: --- priority 1 ( point 7) will go here --- staa
/*-- new code for scr# 16200 */
 IF NVL (:ctrl_block_1.id_queue, ' ') = 'Y'
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO cnt_id_queue
 FROM donor_communications
 WHERE donor_id = :donors.donor_id
 AND com_code = 'DRQST'
 AND com_type = 'DRQST'
 AND TRUNC (insert_date) = TRUNC (SYSDATE);

 IF cnt_id_queue >= 1
 THEN
 NULL;
 ELSE
 INSERT INTO donor_communications
 (donor_id, chapter_id,
 com_code, com_date, com_type,
 com_desc, action_code,
 target_date, action_date, request_code,
 letter_id, staff_no, program_id,
 insert_user, insert_date
 )
 VALUES (:ctrl_block_1.donor_id, :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 'DRQST', SYSDATE, 'DRQST',
 'Record inserted at Onsite Registration', NULL,
 NULL, NULL, NULL,
 NULL, NULL, :banner.prog_name,
 lt_user_session.get_userid, SYSDATE
 );
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 MESSAGE
 ('Error: Not able to insert record into donor_communications table'
 );
 PAUSE;
 RAISE interfail;
 END;
 END IF;

/*-- Step 7.1: ---
if :DONORS.ALTERNATE_ID is not null and :DONORS.ALTERNATE_ID_TYPE is null then
 message('11'); pause; -- staa
go_item('DONORS.ALTERNATE_ID_TYPE');
raise form_trigger_failure;
--check_package_failure;
end if;
*/

 /* ********************************************************************************* */

 --Step 8: SCR# 16203 Confirmation of donor'a sex by donor.(place interdiction on the donor that will move over to lab but will not affect the donor in the donor system and will not prevent products to be labeled- health history and donor response)--message('ctrl donor_id: '||:ctrl_block_1.donor_id||'fdonors d_gender: '||:find_donors.d_gender); pause; -- tmpp
 --message('banner prog_name: '||:banner.prog_name||'banner user_id: '||:banner.user_id); pause; -- tmpp--message('GLOBAL.ACTION: '||:GLOBAL.ACTION); pause;
 IF :GLOBAL.action = 'NEW'
 THEN
 :SYSTEM.message_level := 10;
 POST;
 :SYSTEM.message_level := 0;
 END IF;

 male_female_inter
 (:ctrl_block_1.donor_id,
 :global.multi_chapter, -- Changed "global.chapter_id" to "global.multi_chapter". Changed by Kishore on 05/05/2011
 :donors.gender,
 :ctrl_block_1.transaction_id, -- Added by Kishore on 03/29/2010. IM 3157
 :banner.prog_name,
 :banner.user_id,
 o_out
 );

 IF o_out != 'OK'
 THEN
 show_error ('21131', o_out);
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;

/* ********************************************************************************* */

 --Step 9: If the walkout donor comes back, terminate the attribute
 IF :GLOBAL.wlkattrb = 'Y'
 THEN
 UPDATE donor_interdictions
 SET term_date = CHP_SYSDATE,
 release_date = CHP_SYSDATE,
 release_user = lt_user_session.get_userid
 WHERE donor_id = :ctrl_block_1.donor_id
 AND inter_code = 'DNWLK'
 AND eff_date = :ctrl_block_1.drive_date;
 END IF;

 SELECT NVL (COUNT (*), 0)
 INTO hhcount
 FROM health_history
 WHERE transaction_id = :ctrl_block_1.transaction_id;

 SELECT NVL (COUNT (*), 0)
 INTO phycount
 FROM physical_findings
 WHERE transaction_id = :ctrl_block_1.transaction_id;

 IF ( :ctrl_block_1.allowed_to_donate_flg = 'N'
 OR :GLOBAL.donor_stopped = 'Y'
 )
 AND (hhcount = 0 AND phycount = 0)
 THEN
 SHOW_WINDOW ('WIN_STATUS');
 HIDE_VIEW ('VIEW_DEFERRAL');
 :ctrl_blk_2.msg_txt := 'Donor is not Eligible - deferred';
 GO_BLOCK ('ctrl_blk_2');
 ELSE
 sub_msg := ' Donor ID:' || :donors.donor_id;

 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY ('ctrl_block_1.pb_register', label) =
 'Register'
 THEN
 show_error ('21000', sub_msg);
 ELSE
 show_error ('21065', sub_msg);
 END IF;

 :SYSTEM.message_level := 10;
 COMMIT_FORM;
 :SYSTEM.message_level := 0;

 IF ngallonval - MOD (:ctrl_block_1.s_life_credit, ngallonval) = 1
 THEN
 SHOW_WINDOW ('gallon_page');
 GO_ITEM ('ctrl_block_1.gallon_msg');

 BEGIN
 SELECT error
 INTO verror
 FROM valid_errors
 WHERE ERROR_CODE = '21039';

 :ctrl_block_1.gallon_msg := verror;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 :ctrl_block_1.gallon_msg :=
 'Eligible for the new Gallon award';
 END;
 ELSE
 after_register_steps;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF; -- for no missing data 'ELSE'
EXCEPTION
 WHEN interfail
 THEN
 ROLLBACK;
 CLEAR_FORM (no_validate);
 initialise_windows;
 show_error ('16113', ' ' || v_out);
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN form_trigger_failure 
 THEN
 raise;

Declare
 chrStatus varchar2(1);
 nCount NUMBER:=0;

 Procedure don_proc_change is
 Begin
 If :global.donation_type is not null then
 if :donations.donation_type!=:global.donation_type then
 show_error('21058',' '||:global.donation_type||' '||:donations.donation_type);
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 End If;
 If :global.procedure_code is not null then 
 if :donations.procedure_code!=:global.procedure_code then
 show_error('21059',' '||:global.procedure_code||' '||:donations.procedure_code);
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 End if;
 End don_proc_change;

 Procedure populate_desc(szDontype in varchar2, szProcCode in varchar2) is
 Begin
 select description into :donations.don_desc from valid_donation_types where 
 donation_type=szDonType and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);

 SELECT description into :donations.proc_desc from valid_proc_codes where 
 procedure_code=szProcCode and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1); 

 Exception when no_data_found then
 show_error('2331',' DONATION or Procedure code table');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 End populate_desc;

BEGIN


default_value('null','GLOBAL.don_type');
default_value('null','GLOBAL.proc_code');
default_value(null,'GLOBAL.flgOverRide'); -- This flag value is set in the eligibility window
:global.donor_weight:=to_char(:donors.donor_weight); --- Added for SCR: 151856 LT_2018

IF :GLOBAL.screen_mode='AUTO' THEN --- On-Site mode
 
 If :GLOBAL.action='NEW' then 
 :SYSTEM.message_level:=10;
 POST; -- to pull the data in the eligible window, new donor information needs to be posted
 go_block('donations');
 execute_query;
 :SYSTEM.message_level:=0;
 End If;

 call_window_program('DNWELIGB');

 -- This delete required because if first time by mistake overrode a not eligible don/proc , but again
 -- they come back and put the right don/proc codes. So, terminate the wrong one
 
 delete from donation_interdictions where transaction_id=:ctrl_block_1.transaction_id and inter_code =:GLOBAL.OVRDF; --global @ initialise_windows
 
 If :GLOBAL.don_type is not null then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_register',enabled,property_true);
 :donations.donation_type:=:GLOBAL.don_type; 
 :donations.procedure_code:=:GLOBAL.proc_code;
 POPULATE_DESC(:GLOBAL.don_type,:GLOBAL.proc_code); 
 --DON_PROC_CHANGE; --This is to check if don type or proc code got changed
 check_eligibility(chrStatus);
 If chrStatus='N' then 
 :ctrl_block_1.allowed_to_donate_flg:='N';
 ---select nvl(count(*),0) into nCount from donation_interdictions where
 --transaction_id=:ctrl_block_1.transaction_id and inter_code='DNELG';
 if :GLOBAL.screen_mode='AUTO' then
 PLACE_DNELG_HOLD;
 end if;
 Else
 :ctrl_block_1.allowed_to_donate_flg:='Y';
 End if;
 go_item('donations.donation_type');
 Else
 go_item('donations.donation_type');
 End if;

ELSE --For manual mode (non-onsite)

 call_window_program('DNWELIGB');
 If :GLOBAL.don_type is not null then
 :donations.donation_type:=:GLOBAL.don_type;
 :donations.procedure_code:=:GLOBAL.proc_code;
 POPULATE_DESC(:GLOBAL.don_type,:GLOBAL.proc_code);
 DON_PROC_CHANGE; --This is to check if don type or proc code got changed
 check_eligibility(chrStatus);
 go_item('donations.donation_type');
 Else
 go_item('donations.donation_type');
 End if;

END IF;

EXCEPTION 
 when OTHERS then 
 HANDLE_ERROR;
 raise form_trigger_failure;
END;

Declare
 prev_seq number := 0;
Procedure Check_notes is 
 nCount NUMBER:=0;
 Begin
 select count(*) into nCount
 from central_notes where note_id=:donors.note_id;

 If nCount = 0 then
 :global.note_sequence:='1';
 :central_notes.note_sequence :=to_number(:global.note_sequence); 
 go_block('central_notes');
 Elsif nCount > 0 then
 go_block('central_notes');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 :system.message_level := 10;
 execute_query;
 last_record;
 :global.note_sequence:=(:central_notes.note_sequence)+1; 
 next_record;
 :central_notes.note_sequence :=to_number(:global.note_sequence); 
 :system.message_level := 0; 
 End if; 
End Check_notes;

BEGIN
default_value('1','global.note_sequence');
 if :donors.note_id is null then
 select note_sequence.nextval
 into :donors.note_id
 from dual;
 Check_notes;
 :central_notes.note_sequence := prev_seq + 1;
 else
 Check_notes;
 end if ;

END;

/**********************************************************************************

** For current customers: single user is 'N' and only change in existing code is addition of LT_USER_SESSION.set_userid(v_user_id) after logon
** For curstomers with single user 'Y', new code added.

DECLARE
 v_super_id VARCHAR2(10);
 v_passwd VARCHAR2(20);
 v_dbase VARCHAR2(80);
 v_user_id VARCHAR2(10);
 pass_violation exception;
 pragma exception_init(pass_violation,-1017);
 alert_id number;
 l_user_id VARCHAR2(10);

 Procedure pull_data is
 is_lookup_program VARCHAR2(1); 
 can_goto_main VARCHAR2(1);
 begin
 select nvl(flag2,'N'), nvl(flag3,'N') into can_goto_main, is_lookup_program
 from find_donor_programs where program_name=:banner.prog_name;

 IF is_lookup_program = 'Y' THEN
 first_record; 
 If :GLOBAL.total_found = 1 Then
 If :find_donors.grade =1 then
 If can_goto_main = 'Y' then
 Hide_window('windowfd');
 erase('GLOBAL.LAST');
 erase('GLOBAL.FIRST');
 erase('GLOBAL.DOB');
 erase('GLOBAL.GENDER');
 ERASE('GLOBAL.S_ALT_TYPE'); -- SCR 11774
 ERASE('GLOBAL.S_ALT_ID'); -- SCR 11774
 hide_window('WIN_SCREEN_PASS');
 :global.action:='SELECT';
 next_block;
 Else
 Null;
 End if;
 End if;
 End if;

 ELSE 
 Null;
 END IF;
 hide_window('WIN_SCREEN_PASS');
 exception when others then
 handle_error;
 End Pull_data;

 Function check_prg_access(plUser_id in varchar2) return boolean is
 acCount NUMBER:=0;
 szKeyWord varchar2(20);
 szKeyPos number:=0;
 Begin

 szKeyPos:=to_number(RTrim(instr(:banner.module_name,':',1)));
 szKeyWord:=substr(:banner.module_name,1,szKeyPos-1);
 --message(szKeyWord);pause;
 
 select nvl(count(*),0) into acCount from user_menu where user_id=plUser_id and exec_name= :banner.prog_name
 and mnemonic=szKeyWord;

 
 If acCount > 0 then
 return(TRUE);
 Else
 return (FALSE);
 End If;
 Exception when others then 
 return (FALSE);
 End check_prg_access;

BEGIN

 v_dbase:= GET_APPLICATION_PROPERTY(CONNECT_STRING);
 v_passwd:= GET_APPLICATION_PROPERTY(PASSWORD);
 v_user_id:=GET_APPLICATION_PROPERTY(USERNAME);

 :GLOBAL.lookup_user:=:find_donors.s_user_id;

 IF :find_donors.s_user_id is null then 
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.s_user_id');
 show_error('9171');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 If :find_donors.s_pswd is null THEN
 BELL;
 GO_ITEM('find_donors.s_pswd');
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;
 Else
 If nvl(:global.single_user, 'N') = 'N' then -- multiple users 
 LOGOUT;
 Begin
 LOGON(:find_donors.s_user_id,'IDEMERAW'||:find_donors.s_pswd|| '@' || v_dbase,FALSE);
 If form_failure then
 LOGON(v_user_id,v_passwd|| '@' || v_dbase);
 LT_USER_SESSION.set_userid(v_user_id);
 show_error('16193');
 check_package_failure;
 Else
 LT_USER_SESSION.set_userid(:find_donors.s_user_id);
 If check_prg_access(:find_donors.s_user_id) then
 --Used for registration screen only... 
 -- Added on 12/20/2010; Ashok; LT 4.7
 If :banner.prog_name = 'ONILKREG' then
 If access_elig_window(:find_donors.s_user_id) then
 :GLOBAL.elig_window:='OK';
 Else
 :GLOBAL.elig_window:='NOTOK';
 End If;
 End If;
 -- End Addition;
 LOGOUT;
 LOGON(v_user_id,v_passwd|| '@' || v_dbase);
 LT_USER_SESSION.set_userid(v_user_id);
 execute_trigger('call_find_donor');
 pull_data; 
 Else
 LOGOUT;
 LOGON(v_user_id,v_passwd|| '@' || v_dbase); 
 LT_USER_SESSION.set_userid(v_user_id);
 synchronize;
 show_error('9020');
 check_package_failure;
 End If; 
 End if;
 Exception 
 when others then
 null;
 End;
 ELSE --- GLOBAL.SINGLE_USER = 'Y'
 BEGIN
 l_user_id := LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid; -- IM: 9226 - 02/04/2013
 If lt_password_policy.check_hash(:find_donors.s_user_id,:find_donors.s_pswd) then
 LT_USER_SESSION.set_userid(:find_donors.s_user_id); -- IM: 9226 - 02/04/2013
 If check_prg_access(:find_donors.s_user_id) then
 --Used for registration screen only... 
 If :banner.prog_name = 'ONILKREG' then
 If access_elig_window(:find_donors.s_user_id) then
 :GLOBAL.elig_window:='OK';
 Else
 :GLOBAL.elig_window:='NOTOK';
 End If;
 End If;
 -- End Addition;
 LT_USER_SESSION.set_userid(l_user_id); -- IM 9226 - 02/04/2013
 execute_trigger('call_find_donor');
 pull_data;
 Else
 synchronize;
 LT_USER_SESSION.set_userid(l_user_id); -- IM 9226 - 02/04/2013
 show_error('9020');
 check_package_failure; 
 End if;
 Else
 show_error('16193');
 check_package_failure; 
 End if;
 EXCEPTION 
 when others then
 null;
 END;
 END IF; -- Global.single_user end condition 
 End if; -- password is not null
 END IF; -- user id is not null
 END;

Item.Name: SCAN_ID_BACK
Item.Hint: Scan Donor scan ID . Enter 'M' for manual entry. Enter C to clear the Scan ID

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 szSCAN_ID varchar2(20);
 szError varchar2(100);
 szDonor varchar2(10);
 szname varchar2(140);
 szDob varchar2(20);

 Function EXIST_IN_NEW_DONOR(pScanID in varchar2) return boolean is
 newCount NUMBER:=0;
 Begin
 select nvl(count(*),0) into newCount from new_donor_temp where scan_id=pScanID;
 If newCount > 0 then 
 return (TRUE);
 Else
 return(FALSE);
 End if;
 Exception 
 When others then
 return(FALSE);
 End EXIST_IN_NEW_DONOR;

BEGIN
IF :donors.scan_id_back is not null then 
 synchronize;
 IF :donors.scan_id_back='C' then
 :donors.scan_id_display:=null;
 :donors.scan_id_back:=null;
 go_item('donors.height');
 ELSIF :donors.scan_id_back='M' then
 :donors.scan_id_display:=NULL;
 :donors.scan_id_back:=null;
 go_item('donors.scan_id_display');
 ELSE
 VALIDATE_DONOR_SCAN_ID(:Donors.scan_id_back,:GLOBAL.BC_SCAN_ID,szError,szSCAN_ID);
 If szError!='NO' then
 :Donors.scan_id_back:=null;
 show_error(szError);
 check_package_failure;
 Else 
 :donors.scan_id_back:=szSCAN_ID;
 :donors.scan_id_display:=szSCAN_ID;
 go_item('donors.scan_id_display');
 set_item_property('donors.scan_id_back',DISPLAYED,property_false);
 synchronize;
 set_item_property('donors.scan_id_back',DISPLAYED,property_true);
 item_change('donors.scan_id_back','E');
 If NOT already_used then
 If NOT EXIST_IN_NEW_DONOR(szSCAN_ID) then
 If :donors.scan_id_display!=nvl(:find_donors.scan_id,' ') then
 show_error('21087',' '||:donors.scan_id_display);
 check_package_failure;
 If :find_donors.scan_id is not null then
 show_error('21116',' '||:donors.scan_id_display);
 check_package_failure;
 End If; 
 End If;
 GO_ITEM('DONORS.HEIGHT');
 Else
 :donors.scan_id_back:=null;
 :donors.scan_id_display:=null;
 go_item('donors.scan_id_back');
 select donor_id,first_name||' '||last_name,
 to_char(date_of_birth,'mm-dd-yyyy') into szDonor,szname,szDob
 from new_donor_temp where scan_id=szScan_id;
 show_error('21100',' '||chr(13)||chr(13)||'Scan ID : '||szScan_id||chr(13)||
 'Donor ID: '||szDonor||chr(13)||'Name : '||szname||chr(13)||
 'DOB :'||szDOB);
 show_error('21100');
 check_package_failure; 
 End If;
 Else
 :donors.scan_id_display:=NULL;
 :donors.scan_id_back:=null; 
 go_item('donors.scan_id_back'); 
 select donor_id,first_name||' '||last_name,
 to_char(date_of_birth,'mm-dd-yyyy') into szDonor,szname,szDob
 from donors where scan_id=szSCAN_ID;
 show_error('21100',' '||chr(13)||chr(13)||'Scan ID : '||szSCAN_ID||chr(13)||
 'Donor ID: '||szDonor||chr(13)||'Name : '||szname||chr(13)||
 'DOB :'||szDOB);
 show_error('21100');
 check_package_failure;
 End If;
 End If;
 :donors.scan_id_back:=null;
 END IF;
ELSE
 go_item('donors.height'); 
END IF;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
 HANDLE_ERROR;
 check_package_failure;
END;

Declare
 alt_id number;
 v_alt_id VARCHAR2(5);
Begin
-- Validate only if field is enabled; 
If get_item_property('donors.alternate_id_type', ENABLED) = 'TRUE' then
 
 IF global_var.g_altid_mode IN ('A') THEN -- ALTID required check is only required for 'A', 'B' configurations. For a 4 digit MODE, the configuration of ALTID_MODE must be 'A' or 'B';
 donblock_altID_check; -- checks for DONBLOCK ALTID required parameter.
 END IF;
 
 ---- Check only for a new donor in FD block;
 IF :find_donors.s_alt_type IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF :donors.alternate_id_type != :find_donors.s_alt_type AND :GLOBAL.action='NEW' THEN
 SHOW_ERROR('16007');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE; 
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF; 
 -----
 
 If :donors.alternate_id_type is not null then

 select count(*) into alt_id from valid_master_codes where 
 code_type = 'ALTID' and code = :donors.alternate_id_type
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)
 and upper(code) not in ('C39', 'C417') ;
 
 If alt_id > 0 then
 null;
 Else
 show_error('21057');
 check_package_failure;
 End if;
 End if;

 If :donors.alternate_id is not null then
 If :donors.alternate_id_type is null then 
 nullchk;
 End If;
 End If;
End If; 

End;

 If nvl(:GLOBAL.BC_SCAN_RE,'N') = 'N' then --If scan ID feature is not enabled - do the usual way
 item_change('donors.scan_id_back','D');
 item_change('donors.scan_id_display','D');
 SET_item_property('donors.scan_id_display',VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'display_only');
 Else
 item_change('donors.scan_id_back','E');
 item_change('donors.scan_id_display','E');
 SET_item_property('donors.scan_id_display',VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'NORMAL');
 End If;

END IF; -- new donor check


--------------------

IF (:GLOBAL.action = 'DUPLICATE') then -- This is set in the donor_reel window (Select button)
 
 If :GLOBAL.LAPTOP_TRANSFER='N' then 
 GET_CORRECT_ID_TYPE('TR',IDType); -- it can be TR or TR0 or TR1 depends on the laptop sequence
 create_ids(IDType,trid );
 :ctrl_block_1.transaction_id:=trid;
 Else
 create_temp_id(trid,pl_err_flag,pl_err_msg);
 if nvl(pl_err_flag,'N')='N' then 
 :ctrl_block_1.transaction_id:=trid;
 else
 message(pl_err_msg);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if; 
 End If;
 go_block('donors');
 
 If :system.block_status not in ('CHANGED','QUERY') then
 set_block_property('donors',default_where,'donor_id=:donor_reel.donor_id');

 :SYSTEM.Message_level:=10;
 execute_query;
 :SYSTEM.Message_level:=0;

 If :donors.scan_id is null then
 :donors.scan_id_display:=:find_donors.scan_id;
 End If;

 :SYSTEM.Message_level:=10;
 go_block('donor_interdictions');
 execute_query;

 go_block('donations');
 execute_query;
 
 go_block('donor_pictures');
 execute_query;
 
 :SYSTEM.Message_level:=0;

 /* Check if the donor and donation were registered for the day. 
 If registered, and pull up the record again for some reason the do the following

 1. Change the Label name from Register to Update
 2. Don't insert into online_status table and just update the last_modified_user
 3. If the health history gone through disable the donation type and procedure code
 */

 if :donations.donation_type is not null and :donations.procedure_code is not null then 
 IF global_var.g_photo_enabled = 'Y' THEN
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_picture', 'E');
 END IF;
 
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_register',ENABLED,property_true);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_register',LABEL,'Update');
 else
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_register',LABEL,'Register');
 end if;

 select count(*) into nCount from Health_History where transaction_id=:donations.transaction_id;
 if nCount > 0 then 
 item_change('donations.donation_type','D');
 item_change('donations.procedure_code','D');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_don_lov','D');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_proc_lov','D');
 
 else
 item_change('donations.donation_type','E');
 item_change('donations.procedure_code','E');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_don_lov','E');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_proc_lov','E'); 
 end if;
 ---------------
 If :find_donors.last_name!=:donor_reel.d_last_name then
 item_change('donors.last_name','E');
 SET_item_property('donors.last_name',VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'NORMAL');
 SET_item_property('donors.last_name',NAVIGABLE,property_true);
 :donors.last_name:=NULL;
 End if;

 If nvl(:find_donors.first_name,' ')!=nvl(:donor_reel.d_first_name,' ') then
 item_change('donors.first_name','E');
 SET_item_property('donors.first_name',VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'NORMAL');
 SET_item_property('donors.first_name',NAVIGABLE,property_true);
 :donors.first_name:=NULL;
 End if;

 
 If :find_donors.date_of_birth!=:donor_reel.d_dob then
 item_change('donors.date_of_birth','E');
 SET_item_property('donors.DATE_OF_BIRTH',VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'NORMAL');
 SET_item_property('donors.DATE_OF_BIRTH',NAVIGABLE,property_true);
 :donors.date_of_birth:=NULL;
 End if;

 If :find_donors.gender!=:donor_reel.d_gender then
 item_change('donors.gender','E');
 SET_item_property('donors.gender',VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'NORMAL');
 SET_item_property('donors.gender',NAVIGABLE,property_true);
 :donors.gender:=NULL;
 End if;

 If get_item_property('donors.last_name',VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE)='NORMAL' then
 go_item('donors.last_name');
 Elsif get_item_property('donors.date_of_birth',VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE)='NORMAL' then
 go_item('donors.date_of_birth');
 Elsif get_item_property('donors.gender',VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE)='NORMAL' then
 go_item('donors.gender');
 Elsif get_item_property('donors.first_name',VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE)='NORMAL' then
 go_item('donors.first_name');
 End if;
 End if; 
 SET_EXT_GLOBAL; -- IM 48 
 :Global.flgDataPopulated:='Y';

 If nvl(:GLOBAL.BC_SCAN_RE,'N') = 'N' then --If scan ID feature is not enabled - do the usual way
 item_change('donors.scan_id_back','D');
 item_change('donors.scan_id_display','D');
 SET_item_property('donors.scan_id_display',VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'display_only');
 Else
 item_change('donors.scan_id_back','E');
 item_change('donors.scan_id_display','E');
 SET_item_property('donors.scan_id_display',VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'NORMAL');
 End If;

END IF;

---Duplicate action ends

 /* If nvl(:GLOBAL.elig_window,' ')='OK' then
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.PB_CHECK_ELIG','E');
 Else
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.PB_CHECK_ELIG','D');
 End If; 
 */
 
 If :GLOBAL.screen_mode='UPDATE' then 
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.PB_CHECK_ELIG','D');
 SET_item_property('donations.donation_type',VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'display_only');
 SET_item_property('donations.procedure_code',VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'display_only');
 End If; 


 If (:global.action = 'HOLD') then
 Go_block('DONOR_REEL');
 show_window('win_donor_reel');
 End if;

If (:global.action = 'CANCEL') then
 exit_form;
End if;


 -- Set the age
 synchronize;
 IF :donors.date_of_birth is not null then 
 
 age_yrs:=months_between(p_chp_sysdate,:donors.date_of_birth)/12;
 age_yrs1:=floor(months_between(p_chp_sysdate,:donors.date_of_birth)/12);
 
 age_month:=floor(mod(months_between(p_chp_sysdate,:donors.date_of_birth),12));
 :ctrl_block_1.age_yrs:=to_char(age_yrs1)||' Yr';
 :ctrl_block_1.age_month:=to_char(age_month)||' Mo';
 CHECK_AGE_LIMIT(age_yrs); 
 END IF;

 if :ctrl_block_1.age_yrs is null then 
 age_yrs1:=floor(months_between(p_chp_sysdate,:find_donors.date_of_birth)/12);
 age_yrs:=months_between(p_chp_sysdate,:donors.date_of_birth)/12;
 age_month:=floor(mod(months_between(p_chp_sysdate,:find_donors.date_of_birth),12));
 :ctrl_block_1.age_yrs:=to_char(age_yrs1)||' Yr';
 :ctrl_block_1.age_month:=to_char(age_month)||' Mo';
 CHECK_AGE_LIMIT(age_yrs); 
 end if;

END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN ABORT_REGIS then 
 EXECUTE_TRIGGER('KEY-CLRFRM'); 
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 HANDLE_ERROR;
END;

DECLARE
 v_name varchar2(100);
 v_address varchar2(100);
 v_house_phone varchar2(12);
 v_buss_phone varchar2(12);
 v_extension number;
 v_gallons integer;
 v_donation number;
 v_claimed number;
 
 v_ytd number:=0;
 v_life number:=0;
 v_gallon_file varchar2(30);
 nGallonVal NUMBER:=to_number(LTrim(:GLOBAL.GALLON_VALUE));
 szCreditSpon VARCHAR2(10);
 v_local_time date;
BEGIN
 -- Added by Kishore on 05/05/2011
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, v_local_time);
 else
 v_local_time := sysdate;
 end if;
 -- End of change

 :ctrl_block_1.donor_id:=:donors.donor_id;
 begin
 select description into :ctrl_block_1.blood_type from valid_master_codes where code=:donors.blood_type and
 code_type='ABO';
 exception when no_data_found then
 null;
 end;

 If :donors.ethnic_group is not null then
 Begin
 select description into :donors.ethnic_desc
 from valid_master_codes where 
 code_type = 'ETHGP' and code = :donors.ethnic_group
 and v_local_time between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_time+1);
 Exception when no_data_found then
 handle_error;
 End;

 End if; 


 --color_change('Y');
 :ctrl_block_1.s_life_don := DON_STD.donor_life_unit_count(:donors.donor_id,:global.chapter_id);
 :ctrl_block_1.s_life_credit := DON_STD.donor_life_credit_count(:donors.donor_id,:GLOBAL.chapter_id);

 :ctrl_block_1.s_ytd_don := DON_STD.donor_ytd_unit_count(:donors.donor_id,:GLOBAL.chapter_id);
 :ctrl_block_1.s_ytd_credit := DON_STD.donor_ytd_credit_count(:donors.donor_id,:GLOBAL.chapter_id);
 begin
 select coll_date,to_char(coll_date,'Dy'),unit_id,donation_type,procedure_code,plt_post_count into
 :ctrl_block_1.s_last_don_date,:ctrl_block_1.c_day,
 :ctrl_block_1.s_unit,:ctrl_block_1.s_don,:ctrl_block_1.s_proc,:ctrl_block_1.POST_COUNT from
 donations a where donor_id=:donors.donor_id and
 coll_date = (select max(coll_date) from donations where donor_id=:donors.donor_id) and
 rownum=1;
 exception when no_data_found then
 null;
 end;
 
 DONOR_SINCE;

 
 
 v_gallons:=floor(:ctrl_block_1.s_life_credit/ nGallonVal); ---8);
 :ctrl_block_1.s_life_gallon:=v_gallons;
 --:ctrl_block_1.s_nxt_gallon:=gallons(:ctrl_block_1.s_life_credit);

 :donors.scan_id_display:=:donors.scan_id;

 if v_gallons>=1 then
 begin
 select parameter_value
 into v_gallon_file
 from valid_parameters
 where decode(chapter_id, 'ALL', :global.chapter_id, chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id -- chapter_id = 'WAD' -- Added by Kishore on 05/05/2011 for chapter id institutional level
 and parameter_type = 'ALL'
 and parameter_code = 'GALLON_IMG';
 set_item_property('CTRL_BLOCK_1.GALLON_PIN', DISPLAYED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 read_image_file(v_gallon_file, 'ALL','ctrl_block_1.gallon_pin');
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 message('Gallon Image file not specified in Parameters');
 end;
 else
 set_item_property('CTRL_BLOCK_1.GALLON_PIN', DISPLAYED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 end if; 

 -- IM:9866 ; 01/15/2014;
 IF :GLOBAL.SCREEN_MODE = 'MANUAL' THEN
 SET_RECORD_QUERY_STATUS;
 END IF;
 --

EXCEPTION when no_data_found then
 null;
END;

--

DECLARE
 Dummy_Define CHAR(1);
 --
 -- Begin DONOR_ADDRESSES detail declare section
 --
 CURSOR DONOR_ADDRESSES_cur IS 
 SELECT 1 FROM DONOR_ADDRESSES 
 WHERE DONOR_ID = :DONORS.DONOR_ID;
 --
 -- End DONOR_ADDRESSES detail declare section
 --
--
-- End default relation declare section
--
--
-- Begin default relation program section
--
BEGIN
 --
 -- Begin DONOR_ADDRESSES detail program section
 --
 OPEN DONOR_ADDRESSES_cur; 
 FETCH DONOR_ADDRESSES_cur INTO Dummy_Define; 
 IF ( DONOR_ADDRESSES_cur%found ) THEN 
 Message('Cannot delete master record when matching detail records exist.'); 
 CLOSE DONOR_ADDRESSES_cur; 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;
 CLOSE DONOR_ADDRESSES_cur;
 --
 -- End DONOR_ADDRESSES detail program section
 --
END;
--
-- End default relation program section
--

--

DECLARE
 recstat VARCHAR2(20) := :System.record_status; 
 startitm VARCHAR2(61) := :System.cursor_item; 
 rel_id Relation;
--
-- End default relation declare section
--
--
-- Begin default relation program section
--
BEGIN
 IF ( recstat = 'NEW' or recstat = 'INSERT' ) THEN 
 RETURN;
 END IF;
 --
 -- Begin DONOR_ADDRESSES detail program section
 --
 IF ( (:DONORS.DONOR_ID is not null) ) THEN 
 rel_id := Find_Relation('DONORS.R_DONOR_ADDRESSES'); 
 Query_Master_Details(rel_id, 'DONOR_ADDRESSES'); 
 END IF;
 --
 -- End DONOR_ADDRESSES detail program section
 --

 IF ( :System.cursor_item <> startitm ) THEN 
 Go_Item(startitm); 
 Check_Package_Failure; 
 END IF;
END;
--
-- End default relation program section
--

BEGIN

 END IF; 

 IF :donor_addresses.employer_name IS NULL THEN

 employer.change_intl_address_BTN('D');
 :global.new_emp := 'N';
 go_item('donations.s_credit_sponsor');
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 default_value('NO', 'global.new_emp');

 IF :global.new_emp = 'YES' THEN
 employer.goto_new_employer;
 ELSE
 IF :donors.employer_id IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT NVL(intl_addr_flag,'N') INTO lv_intl_flag
 FROM donor_employers
 WHERE employer_id = :donors.employer_id;

 IF lv_intl_flag = 'N' THEN --- local employer; 
 
 employer.set_local_address(:donors.employer_id, :donor_addresses.employer_name);
 employer.goto_next_local;
 
 ELSIF lv_intl_flag = 'Y' THEN
 
 employer.set_intl_address(:donors.employer_id, :donor_addresses.employer_name);
 employer.goto_next_intl;
 
 END IF;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 employer.select_from_lov;
 WHEN too_many_rows THEN
 message('Duplicate employer IDs in the system CONTACT IS!!!!');
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;

 ELSE -- donors.employer_id is null;
 BEGIN
 SELECT NVL(intl_addr_flag, 'N') INTO lv_intl_flag
 FROM donor_employers
 WHERE employer_name = :donor_addresses.employer_name;
 
 IF lv_intl_flag = 'Y' THEN -- international employer; 
 
 employer.set_intl_address(NULL, :donor_addresses.employer_name); 
 :donors.employer_id := :donor_addresses.employer_id;
 employer.goto_next_intl;
 
 ELSIF lv_intl_flag = 'N' THEN ----- local employer
 
 employer.set_local_address(NULL, :donor_addresses.employer_name); 
 :donors.employer_id := :donor_addresses.employer_id; 
 employer.goto_next_local;
 
 END IF; -- international, local check; 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT 1 INTO ln_temp
 FROM donor_employers
 WHERE employer_name LIKE :donor_addresses.employer_name || '%'
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND nvl(term_date, chp_sysdate + 1);

 employer.select_from_lov;
 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 employer.alert_create_employer;

 WHEN too_many_rows THEN
 employer.select_from_lov;
 END;
 WHEN too_many_rows THEN
 a_value_chosen := show_lov('LOV_Employers');
 IF a_value_chosen THEN
 employer.populate_emp_addr; -- Added on 05/15/2011; AV; populates empl address and move the cursor to next item;
 END IF; 
 END;
 END IF; -- donors.employer_id or donor_addresses.employer_name
 END IF; -- Globa.new_emp YES OR NO
 END;
 END IF;

END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 ln_temp PLS_INTEGER;
 lv_intl_flag VARCHAR2(1);
 chp_sysdate DATE;
BEGIN
 --
 IF is_timezone_enabled THEN
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 ELSE
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 END IF; 
 -- 
 IF :donor_addresses.employer_name IS NULL THEN
 :donors.employer_id := NULL;
 employer.reset_local_address;
 employer.reset_intl_address;
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 default_value('NO', 'global.new_emp');
 IF :global.new_emp = 'YES' THEN
 :donors.employer_id := NULL;
 employer.reset_local_address;
 employer.reset_intl_address;
 :global.new_emp := 'N';
 ELSE
 IF :donors.employer_id IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT NVL(intl_addr_flag,'N') INTO lv_intl_flag
 FROM donor_employers
 WHERE employer_id = :donors.employer_id;

 IF lv_intl_flag = 'N' THEN --- local employer; 
 employer.set_local_address(:donors.employer_id, :donor_addresses.employer_name);
 employer.reset_intl_address;
 ELSIF lv_intl_flag = 'Y' THEN
 employer.set_intl_address(:donors.employer_id, :donor_addresses.employer_name);
 employer.reset_local_address;
 END IF;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 message('Invalid Employer. Select from LISTVAL');
 :global.new_emp := 'NO';
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 WHEN too_many_rows THEN
 message('Duplicate employer IDs in the system CONTACT IS!!!!');
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;

 ELSE -- donors.employer_id is null;
 BEGIN
 SELECT NVL(intl_addr_flag, 'N') INTO lv_intl_flag
 FROM donor_employers
 WHERE employer_name = :donor_addresses.employer_name;
 
 IF lv_intl_flag = 'Y' THEN -- international employer; 
 employer.set_intl_address(NULL, :donor_addresses.employer_name);
 employer.reset_local_address;
 ELSIF lv_intl_flag = 'N' THEN ----- local employer
 employer.set_local_address(NULL, :donor_addresses.employer_name);
 employer.reset_intl_address;
 END IF; -- international, local check; 
 :donors.employer_id := :donor_addresses.employer_id;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT 1 INTO ln_temp
 FROM donor_employers
 WHERE employer_name LIKE :donor_addresses.employer_name || '%'
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND nvl(term_date, chp_sysdate + 1);
 
 message('Select from the LISTVAL');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure; --Kishore
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 message(' No Employer data was found. Select from LISTVAL');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 WHEN too_many_rows THEN
 message(' Too many employers with the specified name , Select from LISTVAL');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END;
 WHEN too_many_rows THEN
 message(' Too many employers with the specified name , Select from LISTVAL');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure; 
 END;
 END IF; -- donors.employer_id or donor_addresses.employer_name
 END IF; -- Globa.new_emp YES OR NO
 END;
 END IF;

END;

DECLARE
 temp number :=0;
 al_id Alert; 
 al_button NUMBER; 
 the_rowcount NUMBER := 0;
 status NUMBER := 0;
 rg_id RecordGroup; 

BEGIN

IF :donations.s_credit_sponsor is not null then -- IM 202
 If nvl( length(:donations.s_credit_sponsor), 0 ) < 3 then -- IM 202
 show_error('9773');
 check_package_failure;
 Else
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO TEMP FROM SPONSORS WHERE SPONSOR_ID = :donations.s_CREDIT_SPONSOR -- IM 202
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);

 If TEMP <= 0 THEN
 rg_id := Find_Group('RG_SPONSORS'); 
 status := Populate_Group( rg_id ); 
 the_rowcount := Get_Group_ROW_Count( RG_ID );
 If the_rowcount > 0 THEN
 list_values;
 Else
 SHOW_ERROR('12033');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 End If; 
 Else
 if get_item_property('DONATIONS.DONATION_TYPE', ENABLED) = 'TRUE' then 
 go_item('donations.donation_type');
 else
 go_item('CTRL_BLOCK_1.ID_VERIFIED');
 end if;
 End If;
 End If;
 ELSE
 if get_item_property('DONATIONS.DONATION_TYPE', ENABLED) = 'TRUE' then 
 go_item('donations.donation_type');
 else
 go_item('CTRL_BLOCK_1.ID_VERIFIED');
 end if;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS then
 handle_error;
END;

 End if;

 if nCount = 0 then

Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 chrStatus VARCHAR2(1);
 alert_id NUMBER;
 nCount NUMBER:=0;
 vTemp VARCHAR2(5);
 
 chp_sysdate DATE;
 PROCEDURE check_previous_proc IS
 BEGIN
 IF :GLOBAL.procedure_code IS NOT NULL AND :donations.procedure_code IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF :global.procedure_code!= :donations.procedure_code THEN
 show_error('21059',' '||:global.procedure_code||' '||
 :donations.procedure_code);
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END check_previous_proc;
BEGIN
 nullchk;
 /*select description into :donations.proc_desc from
 valid_proc_codes where
 procedure_code=:donations.procedure_code and sysdate between
 eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)
 */
 --TR# 1107

 IF :GLOBAL.tz_enabled = 'Y' THEN
 chp_sysdate := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE);
 ELSE
 chp_sysdate := SYSDATE;
 END IF; 
 
 SELECT b.description INTO :donations.Proc_desc
 FROM valid_donproc_codes a,
 valid_proc_codes b
 WHERE b.procedure_code=:donations.procedure_code
 AND a.procedure_code = b.procedure_code
 AND a.donation_type = :donations.donation_type
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN a.eff_date AND NVL(a.term_date,chp_sysdate+1)
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN b.eff_date AND NVL(b.term_date,chp_sysdate+1);
 --check_previous_proc;
 -- Step: 1 Check for missing data
 
 IF get_item_property('donor_addresses.street_name', enabled) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF :donor_addresses.street_name IS NULL THEN
 go_item('donor_addresses.street_name');
 show_error('0080');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 Elsif :donor_addresses.city IS NULL THEN
 go_item('donor_addresses.city');
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;
 Elsif :donor_addresses.zip IS NULL THEN
 go_item('donor_addresses.zip');
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSIF get_item_property('donor_addresses.street_name',enabled) = 'FALSE' THEN
 IF :donor_addresses.intl_address_1 IS NULL THEN
 show_error('0080', ' : International Address 1 ');
 check_package_failure;
 Elsif :donor_addresses.country_name IS NULL THEN
 show_error('0080',' : Country name ');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 IF :donors.alternate_id IS NOT NULL AND :donors.alternate_id_type IS NULL THEN
 go_item('donors.alternate_id_type');
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 IF :donor_addresses.employer_name IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF NVL(:donor_addresses.s_emp_intl_flag,'N')= 'Y' THEN
 IF ( :donor_addresses.emp_intl_city IS NULL
 -- OR :donor_addresses.emp_intl_state IS NULL
 -- OR :donor_addresses.emp_intl_postal IS NULL
 OR :donor_addresses.emp_intl_country IS NULL ) THEN
 go_item('donor_addresses.emp_intl_city');
 show_error('0080 ' || ' : International Address');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF (:donor_addresses.e_city IS NULL OR :donor_addresses.e_zip IS NULL ) THEN
 GO_ITEM ('donor_addresses.employer_name');
 show_error('0080', ' : City or Zip ');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 -- 01/15/2015 -- -- IM 10287 -- new check added to validate with FD alterante ID entry.
 check_fd_entry('ALT_ID'); 
 check_fd_entry('ALT_ID_TYPE');
 -- 
 
 IF :donations.donation_type IS NOT NULL AND :donations.procedure_code IS NOT NULL THEN
 check_eligibility(chrStatus);
 IF chrStatus ='N' THEN
 :ctrl_block_1.allowed_to_donate_flg:='N';
 --the following lines are moved to Register button trigger on
 -- 06-09-04
 /* select nvl(count(*),0) into nCount from
 donation_interdictions where
 transaction_id=:ctrl_block_1.transaction_id and inter_code='
 DNELG';
 if nCount = 0 and :GLOBAL.screen_mode='AUTO' then
 PLACE_DNELG_HOLD;
 end if;
 */
 ELSE
 :ctrl_block_1.allowed_to_donate_flg:='Y';
 END IF;
 IF :global.screen_mode='MANUAL' THEN
 --item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_print_card','E'); -- Commented
 -- by Touqeer based on SCR#16200 on 01/28/2010
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_print_card',LABEL,
 'Print Card');
 --go_item('ctrl_block_1.pb_print_card');
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.id_verified');
 ELSE
 --go_item('ctrl_block_1.pb_register');
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.id_verified');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_picture', 'D');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_print_card','D');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_register','D');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_printers_list','D'); --As per the
 -- IM# 3047 :Added by Touqeer on 03/05/2010
 show_error('16032');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 --END IF;
EXCEPTION
WHEN no_data_found THEN
 show_error('1207');
 check_package_failure;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 chp_sysdate DATE;
Begin
 IF :GLOBAL.tz_enabled = 'Y' THEN
 chp_sysdate := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE);
 ELSE
 chp_sysdate := SYSDATE;
 END IF;
 
 If :donations.procedure_code is not null then
 --select description into :donations.proc_desc from valid_proc_codes where
 --procedure_code=:donations.procedure_code and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 select b.description into :donations.Proc_desc from valid_donproc_codes a,valid_proc_codes b
 where b.procedure_code=:donations.procedure_code and a.procedure_code = b.procedure_code and
 a.donation_type = :donations.donation_type and chp_sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,chp_sysdate+1) and
 chp_sysdate between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date,chp_sysdate+1);
 End IF;

 If Get_Item_Property('ctrl_block_1.pb_register',LABEL)='Update' then
 If :GLOBAL.procedure_code is not null and :donations.procedure_code is not null then
 if :global.procedure_code!= :donations.procedure_code then 
 show_error('21059',' '||:global.procedure_code||' '||:donations.procedure_code);
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 End if;
 End If;
 
 --As per the IM# 3047 :Added by Touqeer on 03/05/2010
 If :CTRL_BLOCK_1.ID_VERIFIED = 'Y' THEN
 nullchk;
 End If;

EXCEPTION when no_data_found then
 show_error('1207');
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN others then
 HANDLE_ERROR;
END;

DECLARE

BEGIN
 :donations.insert_date:=sysdate;
 :donations.insert_user:=nvl(:find_donors.s_user_id,LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid);
 :donations.program_id:=:banner.prog_name;
 :donations.credit_count := 1;
 :donations.set_id := 'ONSITE'; 
 :donations.chapter_id:=:global.chapter_id;
 :donations.transaction_id:= :ctrl_block_1.transaction_id;
 :donations.donor_id:=:donors.donor_id;
 :donations.drive_id:=:ctrl_block_1.drive_id;
 :donations.coll_date:=:ctrl_block_1.drive_date;
 :donations.lookup_id:=:GLOBAL.staff_no;
 --:donations.credit_sponsor := :ctrl_block_1.s_credit_sponsor; -- SCR 152010
 :donations.credit_sponsor := :donations.s_credit_sponsor; -- IM 202

 -- IM:6909; Get credit count from PROCS table. 
 begin
 --
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;

 -- 
 select nvl(credit_count,0) into :donations.credit_count

 If (:ctrl_block_1.allowed_to_donate_flg='N' OR :GLOBAL.donor_stopped='Y') then

 --:donations.first_reviewer_id:=:GLOBAL.staff_no;
 End If;
 End If;

END;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
Declare
 nPhyFindCount NUMBER:=0;
 nHealthHistCount NUMBER:=0;
 chrStatus varchar2(1);
 nCount NUMBER:=0;
 szCreditSpon varchar2(10);
 cNt_ID_queue NUMBER:=0;
Begin

 :GLOBAL.donation_type:=:donations.donation_type;
 SELECT description into :donations.don_desc from valid_donation_types where
 donation_type=:donations.donation_type;

 :GLOBAL.procedure_code:=:donations.procedure_code;
 SELECT description into :donations.proc_desc from valid_proc_codes where
 procedure_code=:donations.procedure_code;
 
 -- The following code is for when to enable and disable the don type and proc code. For example if the 
 -- Health history and physical findings are done, then accordingly do it.

 select nvl(count(*),0) into nHealthHistCount from health_history where transaction_id=:ctrl_block_1.transaction_id;
 select nvl(count(*),0) into nPhyFindCount from physical_findings where transaction_id=:ctrl_block_1.transaction_id and
 physical_value is not null;

 -- 1. If physical findings is done cannot modify anything
 
 If nPhyFindCount > 0 or nHealthHistCount > 0 then 
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_check_elig','D');
 item_change('donations.donation_type','D');
 item_change('donations.procedure_code','D');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_don_lov','D');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_proc_lov','D');
 End if;

 ---2. If both are not done, can modify both

 If nHealthHistCount = 0 and nPhyFindCount = 0 THEN
 If nvl(:GLOBAL.elig_window,' ')='OK' then
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.PB_CHECK_ELIG','E');
 Else
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.PB_CHECK_ELIG','D');
 End If; 
 item_change('donations.donation_type','E');
 item_change('donations.procedure_code','E');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_don_lov','E');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_proc_lov','E');
 End if;

 --- 3. If health history is done cannot modify don type

 /* If nHealthHistCount > 0 and nPhyFindCount = 0 THEN 

 If nvl(:GLOBAL.elig_window,' ')='OK' then
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.PB_CHECK_ELIG','E');
 Else
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.PB_CHECK_ELIG','D');
 End If; 
 
 item_change('donations.donation_type','D');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_don_lov','D');
 item_change('donations.procedure_code','E');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_proc_lov','E');
 End if;
 */
 
IF :GLOBAL.ACTION!='NEW' then -- This IF statement was added on 03-02-05,
 
 If :GLOBAL.screen_mode!='UPDATE' then --the if condition was added 02-25-2010
 CHECK_ELIGIBILITY(chrStatus);

 If chrStatus='N' then 
 :ctrl_block_1.allowed_to_donate_flg:='N';
 -- select nvl(count(*),0) into nCount from donation_interdictions where
 -- transaction_id=:ctrl_block_1.transaction_id and inter_code='DNELG';
 if :GLOBAL.screen_mode='AUTO' then
 PLACE_DNELG_HOLD;
 end if;
 Else
 :ctrl_block_1.allowed_to_donate_flg:='Y'; 
 End if;
 
 Else
 :ctrl_block_1.allowed_to_donate_flg:='Y'; 
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.PB_CHECK_ELIG','D');
 End If;
 
END IF;

 /********populate alternate sponsor if avialble ******************* */
 -- If :donations.credit_sponsor is null then -- SCR 152010
 --If :ctrl_block_1.s_credit_sponsor is null then -- SCR 152010
 If :donations.s_credit_sponsor is null then -- IM 202
 Begin
 select credit_sponsor into szCreditSpon 
 from donations 
 where donor_id= :donors.donor_id
 and coll_date=(select max(coll_date) from donations where donor_id= :donors.donor_id);
 -- :donations.credit_sponsor:=szCreditSpon; -- SCR 152010
 --:ctrl_block_1.s_credit_sponsor:=szCreditSpon; -- SCR 152010
 :donations.s_credit_sponsor:=szCreditSpon; -- IM 202
 Exception when others then
 szCreditSpon:=null;
 End;
 End If;
 
 If :donations.s_credit_sponsor is not null then -- IM 202
 --If :ctrl_block_1.s_credit_sponsor is not null then -- SCR 152010 
 select name into :donations.spon_name from sponsors where sponsor_id= :donations.s_credit_sponsor; -- IM 202-- :ctrl_block_1.s_credit_sponsor; -- :donations.credit_sponsor; --SCR 152010
 End If;
 
 /********* Populate the donor ID verified if available ************* */
 
 Begin
 select donor_id_verified into :ctrl_block_1.id_verified from online_status
 where transaction_id=:donations.transaction_id; 
 Exception when no_data_found then 
 null;
 when others then
 null; 
 End;
 
 /********* Populate the donor ID Queue if available ************* staa */ 
 
 Begin
 
 select count(*) into cnt_ID_queue 
 from donor_communications 
 where 
 donor_id = :donors.donor_id;
 
 IF cNt_ID_queue >= 1 then
 :ctrl_block_1.id_queue := 'Y';
 END IF ; 
 Exception 
 when others then
 null; 
 End;


Exception 
 WHEN no_data_found then
 null;
 WHEN others then
 Null;
End;

 -- IM:9866 ; 01/15/2014;
 IF :GLOBAL.SCREEN_MODE = 'MANUAL' THEN
 SET_RECORD_QUERY_STATUS;
 END IF;
 --

Block.Name: DONOR_INTERDICTIONS
Block.WhereClause: donor_id=:donors.donor_id and release_date is null and :ctrl_block_1.chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, :ctrl_block_1.chp_sysdate) and inter_type in (select code from valid_master_codes where code_type = 'PROPR' and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate))

Trigger.Name: PRE-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
chk_all number :=0;
begin
 -- AV; 05/27/2011
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, :ctrl_block_1.chp_sysdate);
 else
 :ctrl_block_1.chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 
 /* set the donor id */

 :donor_interdictions.donor_id := :ctrl_block_1.donor_id;
 
 /* set the chapter id */

 
 /* Check whether the user has ALL access level */
 
 begin
 select 1
 into chk_all
 from valid_acl_codes 
 where access_code_type='PROPR'
 and access_code_value='ALL'
 and access_class in 
 (select access_class 
 from valid_user_access_classes
 where user_id = :banner.user_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1));
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 chk_all :=0;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;

 if chk_all = 1 then
 set_block_property('donor_interdictions',DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'where donor_id := :ctrl_block_1.donor_id
 and :ctrl_block_1.chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,:ctrl_block_1.chp_sysdate)
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type=''PROPR'')
 and DECODE(chapter_id, ''ALL'', :GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID, chapter_id) = :GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID'); -- IM:9509; chapter_id in donor_interdictions is 'ALL'; 
 --and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id');
 else
 /* set the default where . Inter type should not be DR ( property ) and the
 interdiction should be effective */

 set_block_property('donor_interdictions',DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'donor_id = :ctrl_block_1.donor_id
 and inter_code in(select access_code_value
 from valid_acl_codes 
 where access_code_type=''PROPR''
 and access_class in 
 (select access_class 
 from valid_user_access_classes
 where user_id = :banner.user_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1))
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1))
 and :ctrl_block_1.chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,:ctrl_block_1.chp_sysdate)
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type=''PROPR'')
 and DECODE(chapter_id, ''ALL'', :GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID, chapter_id) = :GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID'); -- IM:9509; chapter_id in donor_interdictions is 'ALL'; 
 --and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id');
 end if;
end;

begin
 select inter_desc into :donor_interdictions.s_inter_desc from valid_interdictions where

exception when no_data_found then

Declare
 v_days_defrred NUMBER;
 v_deferral_period NUMBER;
 v_inter_code VARCHAR2(5);
 v_period_type VARCHAR2(7);
 addingNumber NUMBER:=0;
Begin

 ENTER;
 If not FORM_SUCCESS then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 End if;

 If :deferral.incident_date is null then
 nullchk; --- deferral.incident_date:=:ctrl_block_1.drive_date;
 End if;

 IF :deferral.incident_date is not null then
 if :deferral.incident_date > :ctrl_block_1.drive_date then
 show_error('16047');
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;
 End if;

 If :valid_hh_answers.period_type is not null then ---for temporary deferral 

 item_change('deferral.deferred_thru_date','E');
 :deferral.deferred_thru_date:=null;
 select decode(:valid_hh_answers.period_type,'D',1,
 'Y',365,
 'W',7,
 'M',30,1) into addingNumber from dual;

 v_days_defrred:=:valid_hh_answers.deferral_period * addingNumber;
 
 if v_days_defrred > 0 then 
 :deferral.deferred_thru_date:=:deferral.incident_date+nvl(v_days_defrred,0);
 --This was added for 1.0.6, for M and Y type please add override the calculated value
 If substr(:valid_hh_answers.period_type,1,1) = 'M' then 
 :deferral.deferred_thru_date:=add_months(:deferral.incident_date,:valid_hh_answers.deferral_period);
 Elsif substr(:valid_hh_answers.period_type,1,1) = 'Y' then 
 :deferral.deferred_thru_date:=add_months(:deferral.incident_date,:valid_hh_answers.deferral_period*12);
 End If;
 end if;
 
 if :deferral.incident_date is null and :valid_hh_answers.inter_code is not null then
 :deferral.incident_date:=:ctrl_block_1.drive_date;
 if v_days_defrred > 0 then 
 :deferral.deferred_thru_date:=:deferral.incident_date+nvl(v_days_defrred,0);
 --This was added for 1.0.6, for M and Y type please add override the calculated value
 If substr(:valid_hh_answers.period_type,1,1) = 'M' then 
 :deferral.deferred_thru_date:=add_months(:deferral.incident_date,:valid_hh_answers.deferral_period);
 Elsif substr(:valid_hh_answers.period_type,1,1) = 'Y' then 
 :deferral.deferred_thru_date:=add_months(:deferral.incident_date,:valid_hh_answers.deferral_period*12);
 End If;
 end if;
 end if; 
 go_item('deferral.deferred_thru_date');

 Else --permanent deferral
 :deferral.deferred_thru_date:=null; 
 item_change('deferral.deferred_thru_date','D');
 go_item('deferral.def_reason');
 End If;


END;

Declare
 addingNumber NUMBER:=0;

Begin

IF :deferral.deferred_thru_date is not null then 

 if substr(to_char(:deferral.Deferred_thru_date,'MM-DD-YYYY'),7,2) = '00' then
 SHOW_ERROR('16053');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 end if;

 select decode(:valid_hh_answers.period_type,'D',1,

 null;
End;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 ln_seq NUMBER;
 lb_value_chosen BOOLEAN;
 ld_chp_sysdate DATE;
 CURSOR seq_vmc IS
 SELECT sort_sequence_1 
 FROM master_codes
 WHERE code_type = 'LDOCS'
 AND UPPER(TRIM(regexp_substr(code_desc, '[^:]+',1,2))) = 'COMMON'
 AND UPPER(TRIM(regexp_substr(code_desc, '[^:]+',1,3))) = 'MAPS'
 AND ld_chp_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(ld_chp_sysdate, SYSDATE+1);
BEGIN
 ld_chp_sysdate :=
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled,
 :GLOBAL.tz_offset,
 SYSDATE);

 OPEN seq_vmc;
 FETCH seq_vmc INTO ln_seq;
 CLOSE seq_vmc;
 
 IF ln_seq = 1 THEN -- institutional level
 set_lov_property('LOV_DOCS', group_name, 'RG_ALL_DOCS');
 ELSE -- Chapter level.
 set_lov_property('LOV_DOCS', group_name, 'RG_DOCS');
 END IF;
 
 lb_value_chosen := SHOW_LOV('LOV_DOCS');
 
 IF lb_value_chosen THEN
 IF :lib_docs.file_name IS NOT NULL AND
 :lib_docs.doc_value IS NOT NULL AND
 :lib_docs.session_id IS NOT NULL 
 THEN
 download_doc (fileName_with_ext_IN => :lib_docs.file_name, 
 sessId_IN => :lib_docs.session_id
 );
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
Declare
 /* Modified on 09/24/2013 - SCR 11774; 
 User need not select all the records. Only few records can be selected. One can be 'Y' and rest can be 'H' 
 'Y' -- Selected record (also must be placed on hold)
 'H' -- put the record on hold
 null -- ignore the records (no need to insert into potential duplicates table or place NODON holds.
 */
 nCurrRecord Varchar2(2);
 donor_list Varchar2(80);
 yCount NUMBER:=0;
Begin

 -- Check all the select fields are entered
 nCurrRecord:=:system.cursor_record;
 :GLOBAL.donor_list:=null;

 go_block('donor_reel');
 first_record;
 Loop
 --If :donor_reel.select_option is null then -- SCR 11774
 -- go_item('donor_reel.select_option'); -- SCR 11774
 -- show_error('0080'); -- SCR 11774
 --Else -- SCR 11774
 if :donor_reel.select_option='Y' then 
 yCount:=yCount+1;
 if yCount > 1 then 
 show_error('21124');
 check_package_failure;
 end if; 
 end if;
 --End If; -- SCR 11774
 
 If :SYSTEM.last_record='TRUE' then
 exit;
 Else
 next_record;
 End if;
 End loop;

 go_block('donor_reel');
 first_record;
 Loop
 if :donor_reel.select_option='Y' then
 donor_list:=donor_list||:donor_reel.donor_id;
 end if;
 if :system.last_record='TRUE' then 
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 End if;
 End loop;
 :GLOBAL.donor_list:=donor_list;

 go_record(nCurrRecord);
 If :donor_reel.select_option='Y' then 
 Hide_Window('win_donor_reel');
 :global.action:='DUPLICATE'; -- this will be used in the when new block instance of donors( a new action code) and triger
 Go_block('donors');
 End if;


END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE -- Added on 04/03/2012; commented code at the end does not work for win 7.
 l_exe_path VARCHAR2(200);
 l_defaultWIN7_path VARCHAR2(200) := '%ProgramFiles(x86)%\Microsoft LifeCam\Lifecam.exe' ;
 l_defaultWINXP_path VARCHAR2(200) := '%ProgramFiles%\Microsoft LifeCam\Lifecam.exe';
 l_cmd VARCHAR2(2000);
 
 
 CURSOR master_codes_cur(p_code_type IN VARCHAR2, p_code IN VARCHAR2) IS
 SELECT description
 FROM valid_master_codes
 WHERE code_type= p_code_type
 AND code = p_code
 AND SYSDATE BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, SYSDATE+1);
BEGIN
 :global.user_home := webutil_clientinfo.get_system_property('user.home');
 
 -- Get the webcam executable path.
 l_exe_path := NULL;
 OPEN master_codes_cur('PHOTO', 'PHEXE');
 FETCH master_codes_cur INTO l_exe_path;
 CLOSE master_codes_cur;
 --
 
 -- Check if execuatable exists in Client System.
 IF l_exe_path IS NULL THEN
 -- Check in Win 7 or Win Vista Environment.
 IF file_exists(l_defaultWIN7_path) THEN
 l_exe_path := l_defaultWIN7_path;
 -- Check in Win XP environment
 ELSIF file_exists(l_defaultWINXP_path) THEN
 l_exe_path := l_defaultWINXP_path;
 -- Throw error
 ELSE
 SHOW_ERROR('21212');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 -- IF webcam executable path is configured in master codes.
 ELSE 
 IF file_exists(l_exe_path) THEN
 NULL;
 ELSIF UPPER(l_exe_path) LIKE 'PUSHD%' THEN
 NULL;
 ELSE
 SHOW_ERROR('21212');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 -- Construct the DOS Command.
 IF UPPER(l_exe_path) LIKE 'PUSHD%' THEN
 NULL;
 ELSE
 l_exe_path := get_full_path(l_exe_path);
 END IF;
 
 l_cmd := 'cmd /c "' || l_exe_path || '"';
 --message('cmd ' || l_cmd);pause;
 SYNCHRONIZE;
 
 -- Execute the command.
 CLIENT_HOST(l_cmd);
 
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare -- modified for win7. Also CLIENT_WIN_API_ENVIRONMENT.GET_TEMP_DIRECTORY does not work for win 7

 CURSOR master_codes_cur(p_code_type IN VARCHAR2, p_code IN VARCHAR2) IS
 SELECT description
 FROM valid_master_codes
 WHERE code_type= p_code_type
 AND code = p_code
 AND SYSDATE BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, SYSDATE+1); 
 
 l_client_cmd VARCHAR2(4000);
 l_file_path VARCHAR2(200); 
 l_file_dir VARCHAR2(200); 
 l_result VARCHAR2(4000);
 l_err VARCHAR2(4000);
 l_images_dir VARCHAR2(3000);
 l_defaultWIN7_path VARCHAR2(200) := '%USERPROFILE%\Pictures\LifeCam Files' ;
 l_defaultWINXP_path VARCHAR2(200) := '%USERPROFILE%\My Documents\My Pictures\LifeCam Files'; 
BEGIN 
 
 :global.user_home := webutil_clientinfo.get_system_property('user.home');

 IF :donor_picture_ctrl.s_file_name IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF LOWER( SUBSTR(:donor_picture_ctrl.s_file_name, INSTR(:donor_picture_ctrl.s_file_name, '.')+1)) NOT IN ('png', 'jpeg', 'jpg', 'tif', 'tiff') THEN
 show_error('21214');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 client_image.read_image_file(:donor_picture_ctrl.file_name,'JFIF' , 'donor_picture_ctrl.donor_pic');
 END IF;
 ELSE 
 l_file_dir := NULL;
 OPEN master_codes_cur('PHOTO', 'PHPTH');
 FETCH master_codes_cur INTO l_file_path;
 CLOSE master_codes_cur;
 /* 
 IF l_file_path IS NULL THEN
 show_error('21209');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 */
 
 IF l_file_path IS NOT NULL THEN
 OPEN master_codes_cur('PHOTO', 'PHDIR');
 FETCH master_codes_cur INTO l_file_dir;
 CLOSE master_codes_cur;
 
 IF l_file_dir IS NULL THEN
 show_error('21209');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 l_file_dir := l_file_path || l_file_dir;
 END IF;
 
 IF l_file_dir IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF file_exists(l_file_dir) THEN
 l_images_dir := l_file_dir;
 END IF;
 ELSE -- If not defined in master code
 IF file_exists(l_defaultWIN7_path) THEN
 l_images_dir := l_defaultWIN7_path;
 ELSIF file_exists(l_defaultWINXP_path) THEN
 l_images_dir := l_defaultWINXP_path;
 ELSE
 show_error('21208');
 check_package_failure; 
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 
 l_client_cmd := 'cmd /c for /F "delims=|" %I in (''dir "' || l_images_dir || '\*.jpg" /S /B /O:-D'') do echo %I & exit';
 -- Execute DOS Command.
 exec_command(cmd_in => l_client_cmd, result_out => l_result, err_out => l_err);
 
 l_result := REPLACE(l_result, CHR(10)); -- remove chr(10)'s that are assigned to the result in exec_command.
 
 -- Check for any errors.
 IF l_err IS NOT NULL THEN
 MESSAGE('Error in Read Image routine');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 -- Check for output command and return accordingly.
 IF l_result IS NOT NULL THEN
 :donor_picture_ctrl.s_file_name := SUBSTR(l_result, INSTR(l_result,'\',-1)+1);
 :donor_picture_ctrl.file_name := REPLACE(get_full_path(l_images_dir), '"') || '\' || :donor_picture_ctrl.s_file_name; 
 client_image.read_image_file(:donor_picture_ctrl.file_name, 'JFIF', 'donor_picture_ctrl.donor_pic');
 END IF; 
 END IF; 
EXCEPTION
 WHEN FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE THEN
 RAISE; 
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 MESSAGE('Err : In Read Image button ' || SQLERRM);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END;

DECLARE

 if is_timezone_enabled then

 ---

 NULL;

 END IF; 

 -- Upload to db
 declare
 pic_length number;
 begin
 select length(donor_pic) into pic_length from donor_pictures where donor_id = 'DN00000000';
 
 if pic_length > 0 then 
 insert into donor_pictures(donor_id, donor_pic, insert_date, insert_user)
 select :ctrl_block_1.donor_id, donor_pic, chp_sysdate, :banner.user_id from donor_pictures where donor_id = 'DN00000000';
 else
 show_error('21214'); -- default image not available;

 end if;
 exception 
 when no_data_found then 
 insert into donor_pictures(donor_id, donor_pic, insert_date, insert_user)
 values(:ctrl_block_1.donor_id, NULL, chp_sysdate, :banner.user_id);
 when too_many_rows then
 insert into donor_pictures(donor_id, donor_pic, insert_date, insert_user)
 select :ctrl_block_1.donor_id, donor_pic, chp_sysdate, :BANNER.user_id from donor_pictures
 where donor_id = 'DN00000000' and length(donor_pic) > 0 and rownum = 1;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 post;
 :system.message_level := '0';

 execute_query;
Exception 
 When Others then
 if to_char(sqlcode) <> '-100501' then
 message('File upload failed: '||sqlerrm);
 else
 null;
 end if;

end;
