ProgramUnit.Name: QUERY_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Query_Master_Details(rel_id Relation,detail VARCHAR2) IS
 oldmsg VARCHAR2(2); -- Old Message Level Setting
 reldef VARCHAR2(5); -- Relation Deferred Setting
BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Variable(s)
 --
 reldef := Get_Relation_Property(rel_id, DEFERRED_COORDINATION);
 oldmsg := :System.Message_Level;
 --
 -- If NOT Deferred, Goto detail and execute the query.
 --
 IF reldef = 'FALSE' THEN
 Go_Block(detail);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 :System.Message_Level := '10';
 Execute_Query;
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Relation is deferred, mark the detail block as un-coordinated
 --
 Set_Block_Property(detail, COORDINATION_STATUS, NON_COORDINATED);
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 RAISE;
END Query_Master_Details;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_ALL_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Initial Master Block Cusing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) IN('CHANGED','INSERT') ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Trigger_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to commit the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT);
 --
 -- If user cancels commit dialog, raise error
 --
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --
 -- Clear all the detail blocks for this master without
 -- any further asking to commit.
 --
 currel := Get_Block_Property(trigblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 curdtl := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 IF Get_Block_Property(curdtl, STATUS) <> 'NEW' THEN
 Go_Block(curdtl);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
 IF :System.Block_Status <> 'NEW' THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- Put cursor back where it started
 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 END IF;
 RAISE;

END Clear_All_Master_Details;

ProgramUnit.Name: COMPU_TERM_DATE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE compu_term_date(pl_hold_code in varchar2,pl_incident_date in date,
 pl_term_date out date) IS

 v_fixed_period VARCHAR2(2);
 v_period_type VARCHAR2(8);
 v_period_number NUMBER:=0;
 v_minimum_period NUMBER:=0;
 v_term_date DATE;
 v_status VARCHAR2(200);
 chp_sysdate DATE;

BEGIN
 select fixed_period,period_type,period_number,minimum_period into
 v_fixed_period,v_period_type,v_period_number,v_minimum_period from
 valid_interdictions where inter_code=pl_hold_code and inter_type='HOLDS';
 
 -- AV; 05/27/2011
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 
 DON_INTER.COMPUTE_TERM_DATE(trunc(chp_sysdate),v_fixed_period,v_period_type,v_period_number,
 v_minimum_period,pl_incident_date,null,v_term_date,v_status);

 if substr(v_status,1,2)='OK' then 
 pl_term_date:=v_term_date;
 ---message('Term date:'||to_char(v_term_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'));pause;
 else
 show_error('16171',pl_hold_code);
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

EXCEPTION
 when others then
 message('Error location COMPU_TERM_DATE Proc :' ||sqlerrm);
 check_package_failure;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DONOR_SINCE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE donor_since IS
v_donation date;
v_aux_don date;
BEGIN
 /* To select donor since*/
 begin
 begin
 select min(coll_date) into v_donation
 from donations
 where donor_id = :donors.donor_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 end;
 begin
 select min(coll_date) into v_aux_don
 from aux_donations
 where donor_id = :donors.donor_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 end ;
 if v_donation is not null and v_aux_don is null then
 :ctrl_block_1.donor_since := v_donation;
 elsif v_donation is null and v_aux_don is not null then
 :ctrl_block_1.donor_since := v_aux_don;
 elsif v_donation is not null and v_aux_don is not null then
 if v_donation <= v_aux_don then
 :ctrl_block_1.donor_since := v_donation;
 else
 :ctrl_block_1.donor_since := v_aux_don;
 end if;
 elsif v_donation is null and v_aux_don is null then
 :ctrl_block_1.donor_since := '';
 end if;
 end;
/* To find no of years */
 
--- MG 8/14 :donors.donor_year := to_char(sysdate, 'RR') - to_char(:donors.donor_since, 'RR');
 :ctrl_block_1.donor_year := to_char(sysdate, 'YYYY') - to_char(:ctrl_block_1.donor_since, 'YYYY');

END;

PROCEDURE call_window_program (p_window_name varchar2) IS

 donor_no number:=0;
 donor_list varchar2(80);
BEGIN 

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id);
 end if;
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;

 if :global.action='DUPLICATE' then 
 donor_list:=:GLOBAL.donor_list; 
 end if;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_chapter_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :global.chapter_id); 

 If upper(p_window_name)!='DPWDSCAN' then -- Change made by Kishore on 04/23/09. Added "upper".
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_donor_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :donors.donor_id);
 if upper(p_window_name)='DNWELIGB' then -- Change made by Kishore on 04/23/09. Added "upper".
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_donor_list', TEXT_PARAMETER, donor_list);
 end if;
 End If; 
 -- Change made by Kishore on 04/23/09. Added "lower".
 call_form(lower(p_window_name), NO_HIDE, NO_REPLACE, NO_QUERY_ONLY, pl_id);
 synchronize;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PLACE_INTER_ON_DUP_DONORS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* ** If there is a true duplicate donors, 
 place a hold on the unit and the duplicate donors including the correct donor
*/
/*
 this routine modified on 09/24/2013 - SCR 11774;
 1) insert only selected 'Y' and 'H' donors into potential_duplicates table.
 2) place NODON interdiction only on donors with flag 'Y' and 'H'.
 3) Only 'Y' and 'H' selected donors must be recorded in graded donors table.
*/
PROCEDURE PLACE_INTER_ON_DUP_DONORS(Proc_status out varchar2) IS
 UserException EXCEPTION;
 nYCount NUMBER:=0;
 IDType VARCHAR2(10);
 pl_status VARCHAR2(200);
 s_set_id VARCHAR2(10);
 dupCount NUMBER:=0;
 chp_sysdate DATE;
BEGIN

 Proc_status:='NOT OK';

 -- AV; 05/27/2011
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 

select nvl(count(*),0) into dupCount from donor_reel where session_id=:GLOBAL.session_id;
 
IF dupCount > 1 then ---SCR# 834 (05/14/05)
 
-- Step 1: Insert into graded donations

 Insert into graded_donations(TRANSACTION_ID,UNIT_ID,LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME,DATE_OF_BIRTH,
 GENDER,ACTIVE_FLAG,PROGRAM_ID,chapter_id)
 Values (:ctrl_block_1.transaction_id,NULL,
 :donors.LAST_NAME,:donors.FIRST_NAME,:donors.DATE_OF_BIRTH,
 :donors.GENDER,'A',:banner.prog_name,
 :global.chapter_id );

 -- modified sydate to chp_sysdate on 05/27/2011; Ashok
 INSERT INTO DONATION_INTERDICTIONS(TRANSACTION_ID ,CHAPTER_ID , INTER_CODE , INTER_TYPE , SOURCE_CODE , RELEASE_USER,
 RELEASE_DATE , UNIT_ID , TERM_REASON , TERM_DATE , GROUP_ID , ORIGINATED_FROM ,
 REASON_CODE ,GROUP_MODE , PROGRAM_ID , INSERT_USER, INSERT_DATE , COLL_DATE ,
 COMMENTS ) 
 VALUES( :ctrl_block_1.transaction_id,:Global.chapter_id ,'NODON','HOLDS',NULL,NULL, -- IM 10327 -- inter_type modified from 'HOLD' to 'HOLDS'
 NULL,NULL,NULL, NULL, NULL,'ON REGIS','DUPLI', NULL,:banner.prog_name,
 LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,chp_sysdate,trunc(:ctrl_block_1.drive_date), -- chp_sysdate, IM:7021
 'Duplicate donors were found during registration');
 
 
 GET_CORRECT_ID_TYPE('DUPLI',IDType); -- it can be DUPLI0 or DUPLI1 depends on the laptop sequence
 create_ids(IDType,s_set_id);

 go_block('donor_reel');
 first_record;
 
 LOOP

 -- Step 2: Create the records in the potential duplicate table with the Duplicate ID. Also check how many Real
 -- duplicate donors are in the list.

 IF :donor_reel.select_option IN ('Y', 'H') THEN -- SCR 11774 Added if condition to only process records with 'Y' and 'H' flags and ignore other records.
 INSERT into POTENTIAL_DUPLICATES (SET_ID,DONOR_ID,MERGE_FLAG,TRANSACTION_ID,set_status_code,
 PROGRAM_ID,CHAPTER_ID)
 VALUES( s_set_id, :donor_reel.donor_id,'NOMER',:ctrl_block_1.transaction_id,'PENDG',
 :banner.prog_name,:GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID);
 
 
 -- Step 3: Create the records in the donor interdictions table with NODON holds.
 
 DON_INTER.INTER_UPGRADE_PLACE(:donor_reel.donor_id,
 :global.multi_chapter, -- Changed "global.chapter_id" with "global.multi_chapter". Changed by Kishore on 05/05/2011
 NULL,
 :ctrl_block_1.transaction_id,
 'NODON',
 'ON REGIS',
 'DUPLI',
 LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 :banner.prog_name,
 :ctrl_block_1.drive_date,
 NULL,
 'Duplicate Donors were found during Regis',
 pl_status); 
 
 if pl_status!='OK' then
 message('Error 1: '||pl_status);pause; 
 Raise UserException;
 end if; 
 
 
 -- Step 4: Create the records in the donor interdictions table with NODON holds. 
 
 Insert into graded_donors(TRANSACTION_ID,DONOR_ID,DGM_ID,
 PROGRAM_ID,chapter_id )
 values (:ctrl_block_1.transaction_id,:donor_reel.donor_id,:donor_reel.dgm_id,
 :banner.prog_name,:global.chapter_id);
 END IF; -- SCR 11774

 if :SYSTEM.last_record='TRUE' then
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;

 END LOOP;


/** OLD CODE (Plesse don't delete. sometime we may go b ack to this )*********************

 In the Duplicate donor block( Donor Reel), if there are more than 2 same donors ('Y') were found then only
 those donors needs to be put on hold. If there is only on right donor and others are fasle duplicate then , 
 we don't need to worry about the fasle duplicate-just put the donation on hold. So first check how many 
 duplicate donors are having Y status, then decide to place interdiction or not. BUT all the donors must go 
 as potential duplicates.
 


 Loop
 INSERT into POTENTIAL_DUPLICATES (SET_ID,DONOR_ID,MERGE_FLAG,TRANSACTION_ID,set_status_code,
 PROGRAM_ID,CHAPTER_ID)
 VALUES( s_set_id, :donor_reel.donor_id,'NOMER',:ctrl_block_1.transaction_id,'PENDG',
 :banner.prog_name,:GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID);

 if :donor_reel.select_option='Y' then
 nYCount:=nYCount + 1;
 else
 NULL;
 end if;
 if :SYSTEM.last_record='TRUE' then
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;
 End loop;

 -- Step 2: If the real duplicate donors count is > 1 then place hold on them

 IF nYCount > 1 THEN 
 go_block('donor_reel');
 first_record;
 LOOP
 pl_status:=NULL;
 IF :donor_reel.select_option='Y' then
 DON_INTER.INTER_UPGRADE_PLACE(:donor_reel.donor_id,
 :global.chapter_id,
 NULL,
 :ctrl_block_1.transaction_id,
 'DUPDN',
 'ON REGIS',
 'DUPLI',
 user,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 :banner.prog_name,
 :ctrl_block_1.drive_date,
 NULL,
 'Duplicate Donors were found during Regis',
 pl_status); 

 if pl_status!='OK' then
 message('Error 1: '||pl_status);pause; 
 Raise UserException;
 end if; 

 
 END IF;

 Insert into graded_donors(TRANSACTION_ID,DONOR_ID,DGM_ID,
 PROGRAM_ID,chapter_id )
 values (:ctrl_block_1.transaction_id,:donor_reel.donor_id,:donor_reel.dgm_id,
 :banner.prog_name,:global.chapter_id);

 if :SYSTEM.last_record='TRUE' then
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;

 END LOOP;
 END IF;

******************************/
END IF;


 Proc_status:='OK';

EXCEPTION
 When UserException then
 Proc_status:='NOT OK';
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_FOR_DOUBLE_ENTRY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION check_for_double_entry(pl_field_name in varchar2,pl_comp_field in varchar2,
 pl_find_donor_value in varchar2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 r_chk VARCHAR2 (2);
 no_entry NUMBER:=0;
BEGIN 

check_reentry_for_new_donor (pl_field_name, r_chk,no_entry );

IF Upper(r_chk) ='Y' then

 If no_entry = 2 then

 IF :global.double IS NULL THEN
 if LTrim(pl_comp_field)!=LTrim(pl_find_donor_value) then
 return (false);
 else
 :global.double := LTrim(pl_comp_field); 
 copy(NULL,(:system.cursor_item));
 message('Re-enter value');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 end if;
 ELSE
 
 If LTrim(:global.double) != LTrim(pl_comp_field) THEN
 :global.double :=null;
 copy(NULL,:system.cursor_item);
 SHOW_ERROR('16000');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 Else
 --erase('global.double');
 :global.executed:='YES';
 return TRUE;
 End if;
 END IF;
 Else
 --message(LTrim(pl_comp_field)||' '||LTrim(pl_find_donor_value));pause;
 if LTrim(pl_comp_field)!=LTrim(pl_find_donor_value) then
 return (false);
 else
 return TRUE; 
 end if;
 End if; /************* double **********************/

ELSE
 --message(LTrim(pl_comp_field)||' '||LTrim(pl_find_donor_value));pause;
 If LTrim(pl_comp_field)!=LTrim(pl_find_donor_value) then
 return (false);
 Else
 return TRUE; 
 End if;
END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_ELIGIBILITY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_eligibility(plStatus out varchar2) IS
 szDonorID varchar2(10);
 szProcedureCode varchar2(5);
 szDonationType varchar2(5);
 szCollDate date;
 szEligStatus varchar2(5);
 szDeferDate date;
 szDeferReason varchar2(150);
 szInterType varchar2(10);
 tmr timer;
 Idx number:=1;
 TmpFlg VARCHAR2(1);
 PermFlg VARCHAR2(1);
 TdefReason VARCHAR2(150);
 PdefReason VARCHAR2(50);
 donor_list VARCHAR2(80); 
 maxDeferDate DATE:=SYSDATE; -- modified to CHP_SYSDATE on 05/27/2011; Ashok
 chp_sysdate DATE;

BEGIN
 -- Added on 05/10/2011; Timezone conversions code;
 begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if;
 end;
 
 maxDeferDate := chp_sysdate; -- added on 05/27/2011; Ashok; (defaulted to sysdate in declaration variables)
 ---------- 
 If :GLOBAL.SCREEN_MODE='MANUAL' then
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_register','D');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_defer','D');
 Else
 if :donors.last_name is not null and :donors.date_of_birth is not null and :donors.gender is not null 
 then 
 --item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_register','E'); --3.2.0
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_defer','E');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.PB_comments','E');
 else
 show_error('16190');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 End If;



 /* If there are duplicate donors (potential true) found, then all the donors eligibility should be found. Take the wrost 
 conditions as eligibility. Because all are same donors. That is why it is handled differently. The DUPLICATE actions
 is set at the donor reel select button
 */

 IF :global.action!='DUPLICATE' then
 don_core.check_eligibility(Ltrim(:ctrl_block_1.donor_id),
 Ltrim(:donations.procedure_code),
 Ltrim(:donations.donation_type),
 chp_sysdate,
 :donors.donor_weight, -- SCR: 151856 (LT_2018)
 szEligStatus,
 szDeferDate,
 szInterType,
 szDeferReason);

 if szEligStatus = 'Y' then
 :ctrl_block_1.elig_desc := 'Yes. Donor Eligible';
 plStatus:='Y';
 else
 :ctrl_block_1.elig_desc := 'Deferred: '||szDeferReason||chr(10)||
 ' Eligible on:'||to_char(szDeferDate,'MM-DD-YYYY');
 plStatus:='N';
 end if;

 ELSE
 donor_list:=:GLOBAL.donor_list;
 szDonorID:=substr(donor_list,Idx,10);
 Loop
 --message('Donor='||szDonorID);pause;
 szProcedureCode := :donations.procedure_code;
 szDonationType := :donations.donation_type;
 szCollDate := chp_sysdate;
 szEligStatus :=null;
 szDeferDate :=null;
 szInterType :=null;
 szDeferReason :=null;

 don_core.check_eligibility(szDonorID,
 szProcedureCode,
 szDonationType,
 szCollDate,
 :donors.donor_weight, -- SCR:151856 LT2018
 szEligStatus,
 szDeferDate,
 szInterType,
 szDeferReason); 

 if szEligStatus='N' and szDeferDate is not null then
 Tmpflg:='Y';
 if szDeferDate > maxDeferDate then
 maxDeferDate:= szDeferDate;
 TdefReason := szDeferReason;
 end if;
 end if;
 if szEligStatus='N' and szInterType='PERMD' then
 PermFlg:='Y';
 pdefReason := szDeferReason;
 end if;
 
 Idx:=Idx+10;
 szDonorID:=substr(donor_list,Idx,10);
 if szDonorId is null then
 exit;
 else
 null;
 end if;

 End Loop;

 if PermFlg is not null then 
 :ctrl_block_1.elig_desc := 'No, Donor Not Eligible'||' Reason:'||pdefReason;
 plStatus:='N';
 else
 if TmpFlg='Y' then 
 :ctrl_block_1.elig_desc := 'Deferred:'||TDefReason||chr(10)||' Eligible on:'||to_char(szDeferDate,'MM-DD-YYYY');
 plStatus:='N';
 else
 plStatus:='Y';
 :ctrl_block_1.elig_desc := 'Yes. Donor Eligible';
 :global.status:='Y'; ---(it is deferral flag: 'Y' means good donor)
 end if;
 End if;
 END IF;
 :GLOBAL.old_elig_status:=:ctrl_block_1.elig_desc; --Used in the deferral window close button
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: AFTER_REGISTER_STEPS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE AFTER_REGISTER_STEPS IS
 parmCode VARCHAR2(5);

 Procedure call_hh_pf is

 szKeyWord varchar2(20);
 szKeyPos number:=0;
 Begin

 exec_name='ONIHLTHS';
 
 If acCount > 0 then
 CALL_OTHER_PROGRAMS('onihlths');
 Else
 show_error('9020');
 check_package_failure;
 End If;
 Exception when others then
 Handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 End;

BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.elig_window:=null;

 If nvl(:GLOBAL.AUTO_PRINT,'N') ='Y' then
 -- PRINT_CARD_ONSITE;
 PRINT_CARD_NON_ONSITE;

 IF :GLOBAL.REGNXT='H' then
 --CALL_OTHER_PROGRAMS('ONIHLTHS');

 ELSIF :GLOBAL.REGNXT='F' then

 set_item_property('donors.pb_intl_addr',enabled, property_false);

 go_item('ctrl_block_1.pb_next');

 --Once register disable the button 
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_register','D');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_defer','D');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.PB_COMMENTS','D');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_picture', 'D');


 -- Check if the user can access health history from here, the set enable the button

 If :GLOBAL.ONACCESS='Y' then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_health',enabled,property_true);
 Else
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_health',enabled,property_false);
 End if;
 
 :ctrl_block_1.elig_desc:=:GLOBAL.elig;

 -- Lock the entry
 set_block_property('donors',insert_allowed,property_false);
 set_block_property('donors',update_allowed,property_false);

 set_block_property('donor_addresses',insert_allowed,property_false);
 set_block_property('donor_addresses',update_allowed,property_false);

 set_block_property('donations',insert_allowed,property_false);
 set_block_property('donations',update_allowed,property_false);
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_check_elig','D');
 --:ctrl_block_1.regis_status:='Registered';
End if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: LOAD_LOV_FOR_PROC_CODES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE load_lov_for_proc_codes IS
 rg_name VARCHAR2(20) := 'PROC_GP'; 
 rg_col1 VARCHAR2(20) := 'PROC_GP.PCODE'; 
 rg_col2 VARCHAR2(20) := 'PROC_GP.PDESC'; 
 rg_col3 VARCHAR2(20) := 'PROC_GP.PSORT'; 
 rg_id RecordGroup; 
 szEligStatus varchar2(5);
 szDeferDate date;
 szDeferReason varchar2(50);
 szInterType varchar2(10);
 rowcount NUMBER; 
 lov_id LOV;
 lov_sel boolean;
 chp_sysdate DATE;
 cursor C_PROC_CUR is select a.procedure_code PCODE,b.description PDESC ,b.sort_sequence PSORT 
 from valid_donproc_codes a,valid_proc_codes b where a.donation_type=:donations.donation_type and 
 a.procedure_code=b.procedure_code and chp_sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,chp_sysdate+1) 
 order by 3;

BEGIN 
 -- Added on 05/10/2011; Timezone conversions code;
 begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if;
 end;
 ---------- 
 rg_id := Find_Group( rg_name );
 IF NOT Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 Delete_Group_Row( rg_id,ALL_ROWS);
 FOR C_REC in C_PROC_CUR Loop
 rowcount:=GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT(rg_id);
 don_core.check_eligibility(Ltrim(:ctrl_block_1.donor_id),
 Ltrim(C_REC.PCODE),
 Ltrim(:donations.donation_type),
 chp_sysdate,
 :donors.donor_weight,
 szEligStatus,
 szDeferDate,
 szInterType,
 szDeferReason);

 If szEligStatus ='Y' then
 Add_Group_Row( rg_id, END_OF_GROUP ); 
 Set_Group_Char_Cell( rg_col1, rowcount+1, C_REC.PCODE); 
 Set_Group_Char_Cell( rg_col2, rowcount+1, C_REC.PDESC); 
 Set_Group_Number_Cell( rg_col3, rowcount+1, C_REC.PSORT); 
 End if;
 END LOOP;

 END IF; 
 lov_id := Find_LOV('LOV_PROC_CODES'); 
 Set_LOV_Property(lov_id,GROUP_NAME,'PROC_GP'); 
 lov_sel:=show_lov('LOV_PROC_CODES');

END;

/* go_item('donations.procedure_code');
LIST_VALUES;
*/

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_AGE_LIMIT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_age_limit(nAge in NUMBER) IS
 nAgeLow NUMBER:=To_Number(LTRim(:GLOBAL.AGE_LOW));
 nAgeUpper NUMBER:=To_Number(LTRim(:GLOBAL.AGE_UPPER));
 alert_id NUMBER;
 vError VARCHAR2(200);
BEGIN

 If nAge < nAgeLow then
 SELECT error into vError from valid_errors where error_code='21042' and rownum =1;
 set_alert_property('age_alert',alert_message_text,vError);
 alert_id:=show_alert('age_alert');
 If alert_id=ALERT_BUTTON1 then
 NULL;
 Else
 GO_TO_FIND_DONOR;
 End if;

 Elsif nAge > nAgeUpper then
 SELECT error into vError from valid_errors where error_code='21043' and rownum =1;
 set_alert_property('age_alert',alert_message_text,vError);
 alert_id:=show_alert('age_alert');
 If alert_id=ALERT_BUTTON1 then
 NULL;
 Else
 GO_TO_FIND_DONOR;
 End if;

 Else
 Null;
 End if; 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPDATE_NEW_DONOR_TEMP
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE update_new_donor_temp(PlSession_Id in varchar2,pStatus out varchar2) IS
 v_usps Varchar2(10);
 v_count Number:=0;
 v_data_change_flag Varchar2(1);
 v_last_name Varchar2(50);
 v_sex Varchar2(1);
 v_dob Date;
 szAddrFlg Varchar2(1);
 szDefStatus Varchar2(1):='N';
 szSSN NUMBER;
BEGIN


If nvl(:GLOBAL.street_name,' ') != nvl(:donor_addresses.street_name,' ') OR
 nvl(:global.suite_apt,' ') != nvl(:donor_addresses.suite_apt,' ') OR
 nvl(:global.city,' ') != nvl(:donor_addresses.city,' ') OR
 nvl(:global.state,' ') != nvl(:donor_addresses.state,' ') OR
 nvl(:global.zip,' ') != nvl(:donor_addresses.zip,' ') OR
 nvl(global_var.intl_addr1,' ') != nvl(:donor_addresses.intl_address_1,' ') OR
 nvl(global_var.intl_addr2,' ') != nvl(:donor_addresses.intl_address_2,' ') OR
 nvl(global_var.intl_addr3,' ') != nvl(:donor_addresses.intl_address_3,' ') OR
 nvl(global_var.intl_addr4,' ') != nvl(:donor_addresses.intl_address_4,' ') OR
 nvl(global_var.intl_zip,' ') != nvl(:donor_addresses.intl_postal_Code,' ') OR
 nvl(global_var.country ,' ') != nvl(:donor_addresses.country_name,' ') 
THEN
 szAddrFlg :='Y';
End If;

 --- status Y will print the D on the donor card.

ProgramUnit.Name: PRINT_CARD_NON_ONSITE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE print_card_non_onsite IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 alert_id Number;
 v_rep_name Varchar2(20);
 plStatus varchar2(300);
 plSessionID varchar2(30):=LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid||to_char(sysdate,'mmddyyhh24miss');
 
 filename varchar2(1000);
 report_id Report_Object;
 ReportServerJob VARCHAR2(100);
 vc_rep_status VARCHAR2(100);
 vjob_id VARCHAR2(100);
 pl_parm VARCHAR2(100) := 'ONILKREG' || to_char(sysdate, 'HH24MI');
 val VARCHAR2(2000);
 v_local_time date;
 --url_val VARCHAR2(200) := NULL; --for ORA11g
 
 -- Added on 04/27/2012;
 l_svr_name VARCHAR2(100) := NULL;
 l_svr_url VARCHAR2(100) := NULL;
 l_err_msg VARCHAR2(200) := NULL; 
BEGIN
 -- Added by Kishore on 05/05/2011
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, v_local_time);
 else
 v_local_time := sysdate;
 end if;
 -- End of change

 --Update the new donor temp by calling the package

 UPDATE_NEW_DONOR_TEMP(plSessionID,plStatus);

 IF plStatus='Y' then

 Begin
 select parameter_value 
 into v_rep_name 
 from valid_parameters
 where upper(parameter_code)='FCARD' 
 and decode(chapter_id, 'ALL', :GLOBAL.chapter_id, chapter_id) = :GLOBAL.chapter_id -- Added decode statement to chapter id. Changed by Kishore on 05/05/2011
 and v_local_time between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_time+1);

 If nvl(:GLOBAL.what_action,'X')='O' or nvl(:GLOBAL.flgOverRide,'X') = 'Y' then
 set_alert_property('inform_alert',alert_message_text,'Printing Donor Card.'); 
 alert_id:=show_alert('inform_alert');
 Else 
 If nvl(:ctrl_block_1.allowed_to_donate_flg,' ')='N' and :global.action!='NEW' then -- Donor is not eligible and not for new donor
 set_alert_property('inform_alert',alert_message_text,'Printing a deferral donor Card.'); 
 alert_id:=show_alert('inform_alert');
 Elsif :GLOBAL.donor_stopped ='Y' then
 set_alert_property('inform_alert',alert_message_text,'Printing a deferral donor Card.'); 
 alert_id:=show_alert('inform_alert');
 Else
 set_alert_property('inform_alert',alert_message_text,'Printing Donor Card.'); 
 alert_id:=show_alert('inform_alert');
 End If;
 End If; 

 Exception 
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('21093');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 message(sqlerrm);pause; 
 check_package_failure; 
 End;

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 
 /* Get the report server name from the master code table*/

/* -- Commented on 04/11/2012; Ashok; Below code moved to LTRepServer_Donor.pkg 
 -- Changes made by Kishore on 04/24/09
 BEGIN
 Select description into val 
 from valid_master_codes 
 where code_type='OASVR' 
 and code='RPSVR'
 and v_local_time between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_time+1); 
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 message('Report server is not defined in the SYSPARM table for REPSVR');
 raise form_trigger_failure; 
 End; 
*/

/* commented on 04/27/2012; This will cause issues in mobile pc. So commented it and using only R1 code to get report server url. Same for ONIHLTHS.fmb also.
 -- Added on 04/10/2012 to get least active jobs report server name.
 LTRepServer_Donor.get_reports_server( out_server_name => l_svr_name,
 out_error_msg => l_err_msg
 );

 IF l_err_msg IS NOT NULL THEN
 message('Err ' || l_err_msg);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 IF l_svr_name IS NULL THEN
 message('Error retrieving Server Name');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF; 
 ------------
*/

 -- Added on 04/27/2012
 get_RepServer_Details(l_svr_name, l_svr_url, l_err_msg); -- all are out variables.
 
 IF l_err_msg IS NOT NULL THEN
 message('Err ' || l_err_msg);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ------
 
 filename:=v_rep_name||'_'||pl_parm||'_'||LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid||'.pdf';
 report_id:= find_report_object('LTREPORTS');
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_FILENAME,v_rep_name);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_COMM_MODE,ASYNCHRONOUS);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_EXECUTION_MODE,BATCH);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESTYPE,file);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESNAME,filename);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESFORMAT,'pdf');
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_SERVER,l_svr_name);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_OTHER, 'paramform=no');

If check_wallet_enabled then 
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id, report_other, 'USERID='|| '/'||'@'||GET_APPLICATION_PROPERTY(CONNECT_STRING));
End If;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_session',TEXT_PARAMETER,plSessionID);
 Add_parameter(pl_id,'BACKGROUND',TEXT_PARAMETER, 'YES');
 
 -- Change made by Kishore on 04/24/09
 ReportServerJob:=run_report_object(report_id,pl_id);
 vjob_id := substr(reportserverjob,length(l_svr_name)+2);
 vc_rep_status := REPORT_OBJECT_STATUS(ReportServerJob);
 -- message('Status='||vc_rep_status);
 WHILE vc_rep_status in ('RUNNING','OPENING_REPORT','ENQUEUED', null)
 LOOP
 vc_rep_status:=REPORT_OBJECT_STATUS(ReportServerJob);
 END LOOP;

 IF vc_rep_status='FINISHED' THEN
 message('Donor Card generated'); 
 /* -- commented on 04/27/2012. Ltrepserver_donor pkg not used for mobile pc, so using R1 code to get report server url. (get_RepServer_Details proc)
 -- Added on 04/11/2011; Ashok; Multiple Report Server feature added. 
 LTRepServer_Donor.get_reports_url( in_server_name => l_svr_name,
 out_server_url => l_svr_url,
 out_error_msg => l_err_msg
 );
 IF l_err_msg IS NOT NULL THEN
 message('Err ' || l_err_msg);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF; 
 */ 
 WEB.SHOW_DOCUMENT(l_svr_url || '/reports/rwservlet/getjobid'|| vjob_id ||'?server='||l_svr_name,'_blank'); 
 ------------------------------ 
/* Commented on 04/11/2012; Below logic moved to LTREPSERVER_DONOR.PKG 
 ---added for Global changes ---
 url_val := get_rep_url_donor; 
 if url_val is null then
 show_error('9776');
 end if;
 WEB.SHOW_DOCUMENT(url_val || '/reports/rwservlet/getjobid'|| vjob_id ||'?server='||val,'_blank');
 ---
 --WEB.SHOW_DOCUMENT('/reports/rwservlet/getjobid'|| vjob_id ||'?server='||val,'_blank');
*/ 
 ELSE
 message ('Report failed with error message '|| vc_rep_status);
 END IF;
 
 /*run_product(REPORTS,v_rep_name,ASYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,null); */
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_print_card',label,'Reprint');
 :GLOBAL.is_card_printed:='Y';
 If :GLOBAL.SCREEN_MODE!='MANUAL' then
 update online_status set print_date=sysdate where transaction_id=:ctrl_block_1.transaction_id;
 :system.message_level:=10;
 commit_form;
 :system.message_level:=10;
 End If;
 
 -- End of change made by Kishore
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_next','E');
 
 ELSE
 message(plstatus);
 raise form_trigger_failure; 
 END IF;

EXCEPTION when others then 
 HANDLE_ERROR;
 check_package_failure;
END;

PROCEDURE PRINT_CARD_ONSITE IS
/* This procedure is no longer used. Commented out run_product as it is throwing compilation errors in Forms 11g. */ --Ashok; 
 pl_id ParamList;

 v_rep_name Varchar2(20);
 plStatus varchar2(30);
 plSessionID varchar2(30):=LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid||to_char(sysdate,'mmddyyhh24miss');
 
 Function address_changed return boolean is
 begin

 if nvl(:GLOBAL.street_name,' ')!= nvl(:donor_addresses.street_name,' ') OR
 nvl(:global.suite_apt,' ') != nvl(:donor_addresses.suite_apt,' ') OR
 nvl(:global.city,' ') != nvl(:donor_addresses.city,' ') OR
 nvl(:global.state,' ') != nvl(:donor_addresses.state,' ') OR
 nvl(:global.zip,' ') != nvl(:donor_addresses.zip,' ') OR 
 nvl(global_var.intl_addr1,' ') != nvl(:donor_addresses.intl_address_1,' ') OR
 nvl(global_var.intl_addr2,' ') != nvl(:donor_addresses.intl_address_2,' ') OR
 nvl(global_var.intl_addr3,' ') != nvl(:donor_addresses.intl_address_3,' ') OR
 nvl(global_var.intl_addr4,' ') != nvl(:donor_addresses.intl_address_4,' ') OR
 nvl(global_var.intl_zip,' ') != nvl(:donor_addresses.intl_postal_Code,' ') OR
 nvl(global_var.country ,' ') != nvl(:donor_addresses.country_name,' ') 
 THEN
 return (TRUE);
 else
 return(FALSE);
 end if;

 End address_changed;
BEGIN 

/* Begin
 select parameter_value into v_rep_name from valid_parameters
 where upper(parameter_code)='FCARD' and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 Exception 
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('16205');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 message(sqlerrm);pause; 
 check_package_failure; 
 End;
*/


 Begin
 select deferral_id into DefID from donations
 where transaction_id=:ctrl_block_1.transaction_id;
 Exception 
 when no_data_found then
 DefId:=null;
 when others then
 DefId:=null;
 End;



 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 

 Add_parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER');
 Add_parameter(pl_id,'DESNAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:ctrl_block_1.printer_name) ;
 Add_Parameter (pl_id, 'PARAMFORM', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'NO');
 Add_parameter(pl_id,'BACKGROUND',TEXT_PARAMETER, 'YES'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_drive_id',TEXT_PARAMETER,:ctrl_block_1.drive_id); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_donor_id',TEXT_PARAMETER,:ctrl_block_1.donor_id); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_def_id',TEXT_PARAMETER,DefID); 
 If address_changed then
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_new_addr_flg',TEXT_PARAMETER,'Y'); 
 Else
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_new_addr_flg',TEXT_PARAMETER,'N'); 
 End If;
 -- run_product(REPORTS,'DPRFCBR1',ASYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,null);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_print_card',label,'Reprint');
 
 
 :GLOBAL.is_card_printed:='Y';

EXCEPTION when others then 
 HANDLE_ERROR;
 check_package_failure;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PLACE_DNELG_HOLD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE PLACE_DNELG_HOLD IS
 szOwner varchar2(1);
 v_status varchar2(200);
 nCount NUMBER:=0;
 chp_sysdate DATE;
 
BEGIN
 -- AV; 05/27/2011
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 
 --Get the inter owner
 Begin
 select inter_owner into szOwner from valid_interdictions where
 inter_code='DNELG' and chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate);
 Exception when others then 
 szOwner:='U';
 End ;
 
 
 If szOwner in ('U','B') then 
 
 select nvl(count(*),0) into nCount from donation_interdictions where
 transaction_id=:ctrl_block_1.transaction_id and inter_code='DNELG';
 
 If nCount = 0 then 
 INSERT INTO DONATION_INTERDICTIONS(TRANSACTION_ID ,CHAPTER_ID , INTER_CODE , INTER_TYPE , SOURCE_CODE , RELEASE_USER,
 RELEASE_DATE , UNIT_ID , TERM_REASON , TERM_DATE , GROUP_ID , ORIGINATED_FROM ,
 REASON_CODE ,GROUP_MODE , PROGRAM_ID , INSERT_USER, INSERT_DATE , COLL_DATE ,
 COMMENTS ) 
 VALUES( :ctrl_block_1.transaction_id,:Global.chapter_id ,'DNELG','HOLDS',NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,
 NULL, NULL,'ONSITE', :ctrl_blk_2.rsn_cde, NULL,:banner.prog_name,LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,chp_sysdate,trunc(:ctrl_block_1.drive_date), --trunc(chp_sysdate), -- IM:7021
 :ctrl_blk_2.comments);
 End If; 
 
 End If;
 
 If szOwner in ('D','B') then
 DON_INTER.inter_upgrade_place(:ctrl_block_1.donor_id,
 :global.multi_chapter, -- Changed "global.chapter_id" with "global.multi_chapter". Changed by Kishore on 05/05/2011
 NULL,
 :ctrl_block_1.transaction_id,
 'DNELG',
 'ONSITE',
 :ctrl_blk_2.rsn_cde,
 :banner.user_id,
 NULL,
 null, --populating question code in the group id field
 :banner.prog_name,
 trunc(chp_sysdate), --trunc(sysdate),
 null,
 null,
 v_status);

 if v_status!= 'OK' then
 show_error('16113',v_status);
 check_package_failure;
 else
 null;
 end if;
 End If; 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: LOAD_HEIGHT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE load_height IS
 CURSOR Height_cur is select sort_sequence_1,code,description from valid_master_codes where code_type='HGHT'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)
 order by sort_sequence_1 desc;
 nIndex NUMBER:=0; 
BEGIN
 
 clear_list('donors.height');

 nIndex:=nIndex + 1;
 add_list_element('donors.height', nIndex,HT_REC.description, HT_REC.CODE);
 END LOOP;
 redisplay;
END;

PROCEDURE CALL_NEW_FORM (p_name in varchar2 ,id_plist ParamList:= get_parameter_list('default') )IS
 p_exec_name varchar2(12);

----------------

FUNCTION already_used RETURN boolean IS

BEGIN
 -- message(:donors.scan_id_display);pause;
 select last_name,first_name,gender,date_of_birth into SzLastName,SzFirstName,szGender,SzDOB from donors

End If;

 -- Change made by Kishore on 04/24/09
 ReportServerJob:=run_report_object(report_id,pl_id);

 vc_rep_status := REPORT_OBJECT_STATUS(ReportServerJob);
 -- message('Status='||vc_rep_status);
 WHILE vc_rep_status in ('RUNNING','OPENING_REPORT','ENQUEUED', null)

 --WEB.SHOW_DOCUMENT('/reports/rwservlet/getjobid'|| vjob_id ||'?server='||val,'_blank'); --

 /*run_product(REPORTS,v_rep_name,ASYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,null); */

 -- End of change made by Kishore
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_next','E');
 
 ELSE
 message(plstatus);

 END IF;

EXCEPTION when others then 
 HANDLE_ERROR;
 check_package_failure;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_REPSERVER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_RepServer_Details(out_svr_name OUT VARCHAR2, out_svr_url OUT VARCHAR2, out_err_msg OUT VARCHAR2) IS
 l_svr_name VARCHAR2(100) := NULL;
 l_svr_url VARCHAR2(100) := NULL;
 l_err_msg VARCHAR2(200) := NULL;
 l_svr_port VARCHAR2(100) := NULL;
 skip_error EXCEPTION;
 
 v_local_time DATE; 
BEGIN
 -- Added by Kishore on 05/05/2011
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, v_local_time);
 else
 v_local_time := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 Select description, numeral_value into l_svr_name, l_svr_port
 from valid_master_codes 
 where code_type='OASVR' 
 and code='R1'
 and v_local_time between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_time+1); 
 
 IF l_svr_name IS NULL THEN
 l_err_msg := 'Master code for Reports Server not configured';
 RAISE skip_error;
 END IF; 
 
 IF l_svr_port IS NULL THEN
 l_err_msg := 'Master code for Reports Server not configured';
 RAISE skip_error;
 END IF; 
 
 Select description into l_svr_url
 from valid_master_codes 
 where code_type='OASVR' 
 and code= l_svr_port
 and v_local_time between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_time+1); 
 
 IF l_svr_url IS NULL THEN
 l_err_msg := 'Master code for Reports Server not configured';
 RAISE skip_error;
 END IF;
 
 out_svr_name := l_svr_name;
 out_svr_url := l_svr_url;
Exception
 WHEN skip_error then
 out_err_msg:= l_err_msg;
 
 When no_data_found then
 out_err_msg := 'Master code for Reports Server not configured';
End;

ProgramUnit.Name: EXEC_COMMAND
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
--------------------------x------------------------------------
-- execute a system program then display the output result --
-- Got below procedure from WEBUTIL_HOST.fmb with minor changes.
-- http://fdegrelle.over-blog.com/article-4977737.html
--------------------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE exec_command(cmd_in IN VARCHAR2, result_out OUT VARCHAR2, err_out OUT VARCHAR2) IS
 stnd WEBUTIL_HOST.OUTPUT_ARRAY ;
 error WEBUTIL_HOST.OUTPUT_ARRAY ; 
 process WEBUTIL_HOST.PROCESS_ID ;
 pass PLS_INTEGER := 0 ;
BEGIN
 result_out := NULL;
 err_out := NULL;
 
 Loop
 -- start the program --
 process := WEBUTIL_HOST.Blocking(cmd_in);
 
 -- get the standard output --
 stnd := WEBUTIL_HOST.Get_Standard_Output(process);
 If stnd.count > 0 Then
 pass := 6 ;
 For i in stnd.first .. stnd.last Loop
 result_out := result_out || stnd(i) || CHR(10) ;
 End loop ;
 End if ;
 
 -- get the error output --
 error := WEBUTIL_HOST.Get_Standard_Error(process);
 If error.count > 0 Then
 pass := 6 ;
 err_out := err_out || ' !!! E R R O R !!!' || CHR(10) ;
 For i in error.first .. error.last Loop
 err_out := err_out || error(i) || CHR(10) ;
 End loop ;
 End if ; 
 
 -- release the process --
 If process.handle is not null Then
 WEBUTIL_HOST.Release_Process(process);
 End if ;
 
 pass := pass + 1 ;
 Exit when pass > 5 ;
 
 End loop ;
 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: FILE_EXISTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION file_exists(file_name_in IN VARCHAR2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* 
 Check if a file exists on the client machine. 
 Input is file name (Full Path of the file name Eg: %ProgramFiles(x86)%\Microsoft LifeCam\Lifecam.exe)
*/
 l_return BOOLEAN;
 l_result VARCHAR2(2000);
 l_err VARCHAR2(500);
 l_cmd VARCHAR2(500);
BEGIN 
 -- initialize
 l_return := FALSE;
 l_result := NULL;
 l_err := NULL;
 
 -- Constuct DOS Command. This command returns 'Y' if file exists other wise returns 'N'.
 l_cmd := 'cmd /c if exist "' || file_name_in || '" (echo Y) else (echo N)';
 
 -- Sample example for file_name_in.
 -- cmd /c if exist "%ProgramFiles(x86)%\Microsoft LifeCam\Lifecam.exe" (echo Y) else (echo N)
 
 -- Execute DOS Command.
 exec_command(cmd_in => l_cmd, result_out => l_result, err_out => l_err);
 synchronize;
 
 -- Check for any errors.
 IF l_err IS NOT NULL THEN
 MESSAGE('Error in file_exists routine');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 l_result := REPLACE(l_result, CHR(10)); -- remove chr(10)'s that are assigned to the result in exec_command.
 -- Check for output command and return accordingly.
 IF NVL(l_result, 'N') = 'N' THEN
 l_return := FALSE;
 ELSE
 l_return := TRUE;
 END IF;
 
 -- Return the output.
 RETURN l_return;
 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_FULL_PATH
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION get_full_path(file_path_in VARCHAR2) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
/* 
 Check if a file exists on the client machine. 
 Input is file name (Full Path of the file name Eg: %ProgramFiles(x86)%\Microsoft LifeCam\Lifecam.exe)
*/
 l_result VARCHAR2(2000);
 l_err VARCHAR2(500);
 l_cmd VARCHAR2(500);
BEGIN 
 -- initialize
 l_result := NULL;
 l_err := NULL;
 l_cmd := NULL;
 
 -- Constuct DOS Command. This command returns 'Y' if file exists other wise returns 'N'.
 l_cmd := 'cmd /c echo "' || file_path_in || '"';
 
 -- Sample example for file_name_in.
 -- cmd /c if exist "%ProgramFiles(x86)%\Microsoft LifeCam\Lifecam.exe" (echo Y) else (echo N)
 
 -- Execute DOS Command.
 exec_command(cmd_in => l_cmd, result_out => l_result, err_out => l_err);
 synchronize;
 -- Check for any errors.
 IF l_err IS NOT NULL THEN
 MESSAGE('Error in Get_full_path routine');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 l_result := REPLACE(l_result, CHR(10)); -- remove chr(10)'s that are assigned to the result in exec_command.
 
 
 -- Return the output.
 RETURN l_result;
 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ABBR_QUESTIONNAIRE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PACKAGE abbr_questionnaire IS
 FUNCTION enabled RETURN BOOLEAN;
 FUNCTION is_abbr_eligible RETURN BOOLEAN;
 elig_status VARCHAR2(1) DEFAULT 'N'; -- N -> Not eligible, 'Y' -> Eligible. Used in ONSITE_OBJECTS.POPULATE_NEW_DONOR_TEMP routine parameters.
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ABBR_QUESTIONNAIRE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PACKAGE BODY abbr_questionnaire IS
 FUNCTION enabled RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 CURSOR hh_template_cur IS
 SELECT 1
 FROM health_history_template
 WHERE donation_type = :donations.donation_type
 AND NVL(abbr_flag, 'N') = 'Y'
 --AND :ctrl_blk_1.s_collection_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date,:ctrl_blk_1.s_collection_date +1);
 AND SYSDATE BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date,SYSDATE +1); -- modified as coll date check is causing problems when backdated to earlier date.
 l_dummy PLS_INTEGER;
 l_cur_found BOOLEAN; 
 BEGIN
 OPEN hh_template_cur;
 FETCH hh_template_cur INTO l_dummy;
 l_cur_found := hh_template_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE hh_template_cur;
 
 RETURN l_cur_found;
 END enabled;
 
 /* this function must be called only after donation type is entered*/
 FUNCTION is_abbr_eligible RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 l_qtype_calc VARCHAR2(1);
 l_qtype_comments VARCHAR2(2000);
 l_qtype_reset_flag VARCHAR2(1);
 l_err_out VARCHAR2(2000);
 l_return BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 BEGIN
 IF abbr_questionnaire.enabled THEN
 -- Abbr SCR changes begin.
 abbr_questionnaire.elig_status := 'N';
 donor_questionnaire.calc_qtype( donor_id_in => :ctrl_block_1.donor_id , 
 coll_date_in => :ctrl_block_1.drive_date,
 don_type_in => :donations.donation_type, -- V68 
 qtype_out => l_qtype_calc,
 comments_out => l_qtype_comments,
 reset_flag_out => l_qtype_reset_flag,
 err_out => l_err_out
 );
 
 IF l_err_out IS NOT NULL THEN
 show_error('21220', l_err_out);
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 IF l_qtype_calc = 'A' THEN
 abbr_questionnaire.elig_status := 'Y';
 l_return := TRUE;
 ELSE
 l_return := FALSE;
 END IF;
 ---
 END IF; 
 
 RETURN l_return; 
 END is_abbr_eligible;
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PACKAGE EMPLOYER IS
 PROCEDURE populate_emp_addr;
 PROCEDURE reset_local_address;

 PROCEDURE change_intl_address_BTN (ED_flag IN VARCHAR2);
 PROCEDURE goto_next_local;
 PROCEDURE goto_next_intl;
 PROCEDURE goto_new_employer;
 PROCEDURE select_from_lov;
 PROCEDURE alert_create_employer;
 PROCEDURE set_local_address(p_emp_id IN VARCHAR2, p_emp_name IN VARCHAR2);
 PROCEDURE set_intl_address(p_emp_id IN VARCHAR2, p_emp_name IN VARCHAR2);

ProgramUnit.Name: EMPLOYER
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PACKAGE BODY EMPLOYER IS
 err_txt VARCHAR2(300) := 'Do you want to create new employer?';
 alert_id alert;
 alert_button NUMBER;
 a_value_chosen BOOLEAN;
 intl_count NUMBER;
 ------------------------------------------------------------

 PROCEDURE populate_emp_addr IS
 t_intl_flag VARCHAR2(1);
 BEGIN
 SELECT
 decode(nvl(intl_addr_flag, 'N'), 'Y', intl_postal_code, NULL),
 decode(nvl(intl_addr_flag, 'N'), 'Y', intl_city, NULL),
 decode(nvl(intl_addr_flag, 'N'), 'Y', intl_state, NULL),
 decode(nvl(intl_addr_flag, 'N'), 'Y', intl_country_name, NULL),
 nvl(intl_addr_flag, 'N')
 INTO
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_postal,
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_city,
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_state,
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_country,
 t_intl_flag
 FROM
 donor_employers
 WHERE
 employer_id = :donors.employer_id;

 IF t_intl_flag = 'N' THEN
 SELECT
 zip,
 city,
 state
 INTO
 :donor_addresses.e_zip,
 :donor_addresses.e_city,
 :donor_addresses.e_state
 FROM
 valid_city_state
 WHERE
 usps_id = :donor_addresses.e_usps_id;
 
 goto_next_local;
 ELSE
 goto_next_intl;
 END IF;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN too_many_rows THEN
 message('Duplicate emmployer IDs in the system CONTACT IS!!!!!');
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END populate_emp_addr;
 ---------------------------------------------------------
 PROCEDURE reset_local_address IS
 BEGIN
 :donor_addresses.e_city := NULL;
 :donor_addresses.e_state := NULL;
 :donor_addresses.e_zip := NULL;
 :donor_addresses.e_usps_id := 0; 
 END reset_local_address;
 
 PROCEDURE reset_intl_address IS
 BEGIN
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_city := NULL;
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_state := NULL;
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_postal := NULL;
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_country := NULL; 
 :donor_addresses.s_emp_intl_flag := 'N'; 
 END reset_intl_address;
 
 PROCEDURE change_local_address(ED_flag IN VARCHAR2) IS
 BEGIN
 item_change('donor_addresses.e_city', ED_flag);
 item_change('donor_addresses.e_zip', ED_flag); 
 END change_local_address;
 
 PROCEDURE change_intl_address_BTN (ED_flag IN VARCHAR2) IS
 BEGIN
 item_change('donor_addresses.pb_emp_intl_addr', ED_flag); 
 END change_intl_address_BTN;
 
 PROCEDURE goto_next_local IS
 BEGIN
 reset_intl_address;
 change_local_address('D');
 change_intl_address_BTN('D');
 go_item('donations.s_credit_sponsor'); -- IM 202 
 END goto_next_local;

 PROCEDURE goto_next_intl IS
 BEGIN
 reset_local_address;
 change_local_address('D');
 change_intl_address_BTN('E');
 go_item('donor_addresses.pb_emp_intl_addr');
 END goto_next_intl;

 PROCEDURE goto_new_employer IS
 BEGIN
 reset_local_address;
 reset_intl_address;
 change_local_address('E');
 change_intl_address_BTN('E');
 go_item('donor_addresses.pb_emp_intl_addr'); 
 END goto_new_employer;
 
 PROCEDURE select_from_lov IS
 BEGIN
 a_value_chosen := show_lov('LOV_Employers');
 IF NOT a_value_chosen THEN
 alert_id := find_alert('EMPLOYER_ALERT');
 set_alert_property(alert_id, alert_message_text, err_txt);
 alert_button := show_alert(alert_id);
 IF alert_button = alert_button1 THEN
 :global.new_emp := 'YES';
 goto_new_employer;
 END IF;
 IF alert_button = alert_button2 THEN
 :global.new_emp := 'NO';
 END IF;
 ELSE
 populate_emp_addr; -- Added on 05/15/2011; AV; populates empl address and move the cursor to next item;
 END IF; 
 END select_from_lov;
 
 PROCEDURE alert_create_employer IS
 BEGIN
 alert_id := find_alert('EMPLOYER_ALERT');
 err_txt := 'No match found. Do you want to create new employer?';
 set_alert_property(alert_id, alert_message_text, err_txt);
 alert_button := show_alert(alert_id);
 IF alert_button = alert_button1 THEN
 :global.new_emp := 'YES';
 :donor_addresses.employer_id := NULL;
 :donors.employer_id := NULL;
 goto_new_employer;
 END IF;
 IF alert_button = alert_button2 THEN
 :global.new_emp := 'NO';
 END IF; 
 END alert_create_employer;
 
 PROCEDURE set_local_address(p_emp_id IN VARCHAR2, p_emp_name IN VARCHAR2) IS
 chp_sysdate DATE;
 BEGIN
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);
 
 SELECT
 a.employer_id,
 b.zip,
 b.city,
 b.state,
 a.usps_id
 INTO
 :donor_addresses.employer_id,
 :donor_addresses.e_zip,
 :donor_addresses.e_city,
 :donor_addresses.e_state,
 :donor_addresses.e_usps_id
 FROM
 donor_employers a,
 valid_city_state b
 WHERE
 a.employer_id = NVL(p_emp_id, a.employer_id)
 AND a.employer_name = p_emp_name
 AND a.usps_id = b.usps_id
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN a.eff_date AND nvl(a.term_date, chp_sysdate + 1); 
 END set_local_address;

 PROCEDURE set_intl_address(p_emp_id IN VARCHAR2, p_emp_name IN VARCHAR2) IS
 chp_sysdate DATE;
 BEGIN
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);
 
 SELECT
 a.employer_id,
 a.intl_city,
 a.intl_state,
 a.intl_postal_code,
 intl_country_name
 INTO
 :donor_addresses.employer_id,
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_city,
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_state,
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_postal,
 :donor_addresses.emp_intl_country
 FROM
 donor_employers a
 WHERE
 a.employer_id = NVL(p_emp_id, a.employer_id)
 AND a.employer_name = p_emp_name
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN a.eff_date AND nvl(a.term_date, chp_sysdate + 1); 
 END set_intl_address; 
END;

RecordGroup.Name: RG_EMPLOYERS
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select 
a.employer_name, 
a.employer_id, 
decode(nvl(intl_addr_flag,'N'), 'Y', a.intl_postal_code, b.zip) ZIP, 
decode(nvl(intl_addr_flag,'N'), 'Y', a.intl_city, b.city) CITY, 
decode(nvl(intl_addr_flag,'N'), 'Y', a.intl_state, b.state) STATE,
decode(nvl(intl_addr_flag,'N'), 'Y', a.intl_country_name, 'USA') COUNTRY,
a.usps_id 
from donor_employers a , valid_city_state b 
where a.usps_id = b.usps_id 
and employer_name like '%'||:donor_addresses.employer_name||'%' 
and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate)+1) 
order by 1,4,3

RecordGroup.Name: RG_E_COUNTRY
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select distinct code, description 
from valid_master_codes
where code_type = 'CNTRY' 
and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1)

RecordGroup.Name: RG_DONATION_TYPES
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select distinct a.donation_type,b.description, b.sort_sequence from valid_donproc_codes a,valid_donation_types b where a.donation_type = b.donation_type and a.donation_type!='99' and sysdate between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date,sysdate+1) order by b.sort_sequence

RecordGroup.Name: RG_PROC_CODES
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select distinct a.procedure_code PCODE, b.description PDESC,b.sort_sequence PSORT from valid_donproc_codes a, valid_proc_codes b where b.procedure_code!='99' and a.procedure_code = b.procedure_code and a.donation_type = :donations.donation_type and sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,sysdate+1) and sysdate between b.eff_date and
nvl(b.term_date,sysdate+1) order by b.sort_sequence

RecordGroup.Name: RG_DRIVES
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select to_char(c.drive_date,'MMDDRRRR') d_date, a.drive_id, initcap(b.name) name from drive_sponsors a , sponsors b, drives c where c.drive_date = nvl(:ctrl_block_1.drive_date,sysdate) and c.status='CNFRM' and a.sponsor_id = b.sponsor_id and a.drive_id = c.drive_id order by a.projected_draw desc

RecordGroup.Name: RG_ALTID
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select code,description from valid_master_codes where
code_type='ALTID' and sysdate between eff_date and
nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) and upper(code) not in ('C39', 'C417')

RecordGroup.Name: RG_OVERRIDE_RSN
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select code,description from valid_master_codes where code_type='OVRSN' and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)

RecordGroup.Name: RG_ETHNIC
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select code, description from valid_master_codes where code_type = 'ETHGP' and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) order by sort_sequence_1

RecordGroup.Name: RG_ZIPS
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select zip , city ,state,usps_id from valid_city_state where (city = :donor_addresses.city) and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)

RecordGroup.Name: RG_E_ZIP
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select zip , city ,state,usps_id from valid_city_state where (city = :donor_addresses.e_city) and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)

RecordGroup.Name: RG_FIXED_SITE_STAFF
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select distinct a.staff_no,a.Last_name from employees a, drives b, fixed_site_staff c
where b.drive_type='F' and b.location_id=c.site_id and a.staff_no=c.staff_no

RecordGroup.Name: RG_CITY
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select city ,state, zip usps_id from valid_city_state where city like :donor_addresses.city||'%' and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) order by 1

RecordGroup.Name: RG_E_CITY
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select city ,state, zip usps_id from valid_city_state where city like :donor_addresses.e_city||'%' and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) order by 1

RecordGroup.Name: PRINTER_RG
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select code,code_desc des from rpt_master_codes
where code_type='DDEM'
order by 1

RecordGroup.Name: RG_SPONSORS
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select a.name sname,a.sponsor_id sponid,
b.street_name ||' '||c.city||' '||c.state||'-'||c.zip addr from sponsors a,
addresses b, valid_city_state c where a.term_date is null and sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,sysdate+1) and a.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and a.name like decode(:donations.credit_sponsor,null,'%','%'||:donations.credit_sponsor||'%') and a.address_id=b.address_id and 
sysdate between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date,sysdate+1) and
b.usps_id=c.usps_id and
sysdate between c.eff_date and nvl(c.term_date,sysdate+1) 
order by 1

 t_fcn varchar2(30) := get_application_property(current_form_name);
begin
 select distinct 'x' into :global.x
 from user_menu
 where exec_name = upper(t_fcn);
exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('9771');
 exit_form(no_validate);
 when others then
 handle_error;
 exit_form(no_validate);
end;

declare
 msg number;
begin
 select count(msg_id)
 into msg
 from alert_log
 where user_id = LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid
 and read_date is null;
 
 if msg > 0 then
 set_item_property('toolbar.pb_alerts',label,'Msg: '||to_char(msg));
 end if;
exception
 when program_error then
 null; 
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-CLRFRM
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 set_block_property('donors',update_allowed,property_true);
 set_block_property('donors',insert_allowed,property_true);
 set_block_property('donations',update_allowed,property_true);
 set_block_property('donations',insert_allowed,property_true);
 set_block_property('donor_addresses',update_allowed,property_true);
 set_block_property('donor_addresses',insert_allowed,property_true);
 -- set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_print_card',enabled,property_true);
 IF :GLOBAL.SCREEN_MODE in ('AUTO','UPDATE') then
 clear_form(no_validate);
 erase('GLOBAL.LINK');
 initialise_windows;
 ELSE --(MANUAL)
 If :GLOBAL.is_card_printed='N' then
 if get_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_print_card', ENABLED) = 'TRUE' then -- Added on 05/02/2011; To fix navigational errors for manual screen mode.
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.pb_print_card');
 execute_trigger('WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED');
 end if;
 clear_form(no_validate);
 initialise_windows;
 Else
 GO_TO_FIND_DONOR;
 -- clear_form(no_validate);
 -- initialise_windows;
 End if;
 END IF;
END;
